title: Systems & Reporting Analyst – Construction
description:
We are a U.S.-based construction company managing residential renovations, rehabs, turns, and construction projects across multiple markets.



We are looking for a highly analytical and systems-oriented **Systems & Reporting Analyst** to own and improve the technology and reporting systems used to manage our operations.



The primary systems for this role will include **SiteCapture, Power BI, Excel/Google Sheets, QuickBooks data, and other construction/project management platforms**.



This person will be responsible for ensuring our systems contain accurate information, building dashboards and reports for management, identifying missing or incorrect data, automating repetitive processes, and continuously improving how information moves through the company.



This is not a general administrative position.



We are looking for someone who enjoys systems, data, automation, reporting, and solving operational problems.





Primary Responsibilities



SiteCapture Administration



You will become the internal owner of SiteCapture.



Responsibilities include:



* Build and maintain SiteCapture templates.

* Create standardized inspection and project forms.

* Maintain project workflows.

* Configure required photos, questions, fields, and documentation.

* Create templates for different clients and project types.

* Maintain naming standards and project organization.

* Add new projects and ensure they are set up correctly.

* Create and maintain user accounts and permissions.

* Troubleshoot SiteCapture issues for Project Managers and field personnel.

* Review submissions for missing information.

* Identify incomplete inspections and missing photos.

* Track whether required inspections have been completed.

* Improve SiteCapture workflows based on feedback from the field.

* Reduce unnecessary fields and duplicate work.

* Create processes that make field reporting simple and consistent.



The objective is for SiteCapture to become the primary source of accurate field information for every project.



Power BI Reporting & Dashboards



Build and maintain management dashboards that provide real-time visibility into company operations.



Dashboards may include:



Project Dashboard



* Active projects

* Contract amount

* Project Manager

* Market

* Client

* Start date

* Estimated completion date

* Current project phase

* Percentage complete

* Days active

* Days behind schedule

* Outstanding punch-list items

* Project status



Financial Dashboard



* Contract value

* Amount invoiced

* Amount collected

* Accounts receivable

* Outstanding client balances

* Project costs

* Gross profit

* Gross margin

* Estimated profit at completion

* Cash remaining by project

* Unbilled work



Project Manager Dashboard



* Projects assigned

* Total contract value managed

* Projects completed

* Average project duration

* Projects behind schedule

* Outstanding inspections

* Open client requests

* Open punch-list items

* Project gross margins



### Client Dashboard



* Revenue by client

* Number of projects

* Average project size

* Average margin

* Average completion time

* Accounts receivable

* Payment speed

* Active pipeline



 Market Dashboard



Reporting by geographic market, including:



* Revenue

* Active projects

* Gross profit

* Gross margin

* Project count

* Average project size

* Accounts receivable

* Pipeline

* Project Manager performance



## Data Management



Maintain accurate data across company systems.



Responsibilities include:



* Audit project data regularly.

* Identify missing or incorrect information.

* Correct data inconsistencies.

* Maintain standardized project names and IDs.

* Maintain client and market classifications.

* Ensure projects are properly assigned to Project Managers.

* Maintain project status definitions.

* Create standardized data structures across systems.

* Create master project databases where necessary.

* Reconcile information between systems.



The company should not have conflicting versions of the same project information.



## Systems Integration



Work toward connecting company systems so information does not need to be entered multiple times.



Potential systems may include:



* SiteCapture

* QuickBooks Online

* Power BI

* Microsoft Excel

* Google Sheets

* Airtable

* CompanyCam

*

* Accounting systems

* Client portals

* Construction management platforms



Responsibilities may include:



* APIs

* Power Automate

* Zapier

* Make

* Data exports/imports

* Excel Power Query

* SQL databases

* Cloud data connections



The goal is to automate repetitive administrative work wherever practical.



## Workflow Automation



Identify repetitive tasks being performed manually and determine whether they can be automated.



Examples include:



* Automatically creating projects.

* Automatically generating reports.

* Sending alerts when projects become overdue.

* Flagging missing SiteCapture inspections.

* Flagging missing photos.

* Alerting management when project margins decline.

* Automatically updating project dashboards.

* Creating weekly management reports.

* Identifying overdue invoices.

* Identifying projects that have not been updated recently.

* Tracking missing documentation.



## Reporting



Prepare recurring reports for management.



### Daily Reporting



Provide visibility into:



* Projects requiring attention.

* Projects behind schedule.

* Missing SiteCapture updates.

* Missing inspections.

* Projects without recent activity.

* Major data issues.



### Weekly Reporting



Prepare a management dashboard covering:



* Active projects.

* Projects started.

* Projects completed.

* Contract value.

* Revenue invoiced.

* Revenue collected.

* Accounts receivable.

* Gross profit.

* Gross margin.

* Project delays.

* Pipeline.

* Project Manager performance.



Management should be able to understand the condition of the business without manually searching through multiple systems.



## System Documentation



Create clear documentation for company systems and processes.



This includes:



* Standard operating procedures.

* SiteCapture instructions.

* Dashboard definitions.

* Data entry standards.

* Project setup instructions.

* Reporting processes.

* System integration documentation.

* Employee training guides.



Processes should not exist only in one person's memory.



## Systems Improvement



Continuously identify opportunities to improve how the company operates.



You should regularly ask:



* Why are we entering this information twice?

* Why does management have to manually find this information?

* Can this be automated?

* Is this data accurate?

* Is anyone actually using this field?

* Can this workflow be simpler?

* Can we identify this problem sooner?

* Can management see this information on a dashboard?



The goal is not simply to maintain existing systems.



The goal is to **make the systems better.**



## Key Performance Indicators



Performance will be measured based on:



* Accuracy of company reporting.

* SiteCapture compliance.

* Percentage of projects with complete required data.

* Number of missing inspections/photos.

* Dashboard accuracy.

* Reporting delivered on schedule.

* Reduction in manual administrative work.

* Number of workflows automated.

* System uptime and reliability.

* Speed of correcting data issues.

* Adoption of systems by field and office staff.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate has experience with several of the following:



* Power BI

* Microsoft Excel

* Power Query

* SiteCapture or similar field inspection software

* SQL

* APIs

* Power Automate

* Zapier

* Make

* Google Sheets

* Airtable

* QuickBooks Online

* Construction management software

* Data analytics

* Business intelligence

* Process automation



Strong Power BI and Excel skills are highly preferred.



Construction experience is helpful but not required.



A candidate with strong systems and analytical skills can learn the construction terminology.



## Required Characteristics



We are looking for someone who is:



* Extremely detail-oriented.

* Analytical.

* Naturally curious.

* Comfortable troubleshooting problems.

* Able to work independently.

* Comfortable learning new software.

* Able to understand business processes.

* Able to identify inefficiencies.

* Comfortable working with large amounts of data.

* Able to explain technical information simply.

* Proactive rather than waiting for instructions.



If you notice bad data, you should investigate it.



If you see a process being repeated manually, you should ask whether it can be automated.



If a dashboard number does not make sense, you should determine why.



## What Success Looks Like



Within this role, management should eventually be able to open one Power BI dashboard and understand:



**What projects do we have?**



**How much are they worth?**



**How much have we billed?**



**How much have we collected?**



**What have we spent?**



**What is our expected profit?**



**Which projects are behind?**



**Which Project Managers need attention?**



**Which clients owe us money?**



**What work is coming next?**



The Systems & Reporting Analyst is responsible for building the infrastructure that makes those answers reliable and easy to access.



The ultimate goal is to create a company where decisions are based on accurate, real-time information rather than spreadsheets, text messages, memory, or manually searching through multiple systems.

title: Key Account Manager – B2B Sales, Global Sourcing & Product Procurement
description:
We are looking for a strong Key Account Manager to join 
.



This is a sales role for someone who can prospect, pitch, negotiate, close deals, and manage long-term B2B client relationships.



This is not a role for someone who waits for leads to be handed to them. We need someone who can build their own pipeline, contact business owners and procurement teams, understand their sourcing needs, and turn conversations into signed deals or confirmed orders.



At 
, we help businesses source products globally. We work with clients who need reliable suppliers, better pricing, bulk procurement, product sourcing, and logistics support.



Once you close a deal, your role does not end there. You will continue to manage the client relationship and work closely with our sourcing and logistics teams to make sure we deliver what was promised.



This role includes a competitive base salary plus commission on every eligible deal you close.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Build and manage your own B2B sales pipeline.

* Identify and contact business owners, procurement managers, purchasing officers, and decision-makers.

* Prospect through phone,
, LinkedIn, referrals, online research, and other approved channels.

* Qualify leads and identify genuine buying opportunities.

* Target bulk B2B buyers across different industries.

* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable sourcing solutions.

* Work with internal sourcing and logistics teams to support quotations and proposals.

* Lead negotiations for bulk orders, recurring supply arrangements, and long-term contracts.

* Follow up consistently until the opportunity is closed or clearly finalised.

* Close deals and secure purchase orders or contracts.

* Manage client relationships after the sale.

* Maintain accurate CRM records.

* Provide regular updates on pipeline, leads, RFQs, quotations, follow-ups, and closed deals.

* Meet agreed monthly and quarterly sales targets.



You will focus on B2B buyers in industries such as:



* Healthcare and medical supplies

  Example: hospital beds, wheelchairs, PPE, medical equipment.

* Renewable energy

  Example: solar equipment, batteries, electrical supplies.

* Commercial furniture

  Example: office furniture, hotel furniture, school furniture.

* Security and surveillance

  Example: CCTV, access control, security systems.

* IT hardware and technology supplies.

* Construction and industrial supplies.

* Hospitality and facility supplies.

* Other bulk procurement categories.



We are looking for someone who:



* Has **7 to 10 years of strong B2B sales experience**.

* Has experience in trading, wholesale, procurement, sourcing, logistics, import/export, distribution, or related industries.

* Can confidently speak with business owners, procurement teams, and senior decision-makers.

* Knows how to build a pipeline independently.

* Is confident in prospecting, pitching, negotiating, and closing deals.

* Has strong follow-up discipline.

* Can manage long sales cycles without losing 
ntum.

* Is comfortable working with targets, KPIs, CRM updates, and sales reporting.

* Takes ownership of results.

* Communicates clearly and professionally.

* Can work independently in a fast-moving business.

* Does not wait to be told every step.



It would be a strong advantage if you have:



* Existing contacts or network with bulk buyers or procurement decision-makers.

* Experience selling to healthcare, renewable energy, commercial furniture, IT/security, construction, or industrial clients.

* Experience with China sourcing, global sourcing, import/export, or logistics.

* Experience closing high-value B2B deals.

* Knowledge of freight, shipping, supply chain, or procurement processes.

* Experience with recurring supply contracts or long-term purchasing agreements.



What We Offer

* Competitive base salary.

* Commission on every eligible deal you close.

* No commission cap for strong performers.

* A real B2B product and service offering with strong market potential.

* Opportunity to work with a growing global sourcing and procurement business.

* A lean and fast-moving team where performance is noticed.

* Long-term growth opportunities as the company expands.

* The opportunity to build your own client portfolio.



Please only apply if you have strong experience in:



* B2B Sales

* Business Development

* Lead Generation

* Cold Calling

* LinkedIn Prospecting

* Negotiation

* Account Management

* CRM Management

* Client Relationship Management

* Closing Deals



To apply, please send the following:



1. Your updated resume

2. A short video introduction of 2 to 3 minutes answering the following questions:



* Who are you?

* What is your B2B sales experience?

* What industries have you sold into?

* What is the biggest or most meaningful deal you have helped close?

* Why do you believe you would be a strong fit for 
?



Please use this subject line when applying:



**KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER – ANYTHING SUPPLIES**



Applications without a resume and video introduction may not be reviewed.

title: Automation & Funnel Specialist (GoHighLevel, Wordpress, Shopify)
description:
Automation & Funnel Specialist (GoHighLevel, Wordpress, Shopify)



Web systems, funnels, and automation | WordPress + GoHighLevel + Pabbly



Full-time | Remote | Permanent | Semi-flexible schedule





--- ABOUT THE ROLE ---



Built on a vision to empower professionals worldwide into thought leaders, our North-American company fosters a mission-driven culture where every tea
mber feels supported, listened to, and valued, driving trust, growth, and creativity while building a lasting legacy of impact worldwide.  We are looking for one person to own and operate our technical stack: the website, the funnels, and the connected systems for
, automation, and tracking.



This is a dedicated in-house role. There is no agency-style client rotation, no looking for clients, and no handing off projects only to never see them finished. You build the systems, monitor their performance, and improve them. Because you run the stack, you see the long-term results of your work. It is an opportunity to take ownership and level up your skills as our systems evolve.



We are looking for a balanced skill set:



• Technical expertise: You know your way around GoHighLevel and Pabbly to build connected workflows, and tweaking PHP snippets does not slow you down.

• An eye for design: You can design, assemble and build clean, on-brand funnels and pages by yourself when we need to launch fast. This would keep projects moving forward without needing to wait on our design team.

• A curious mindset: You naturally look for ways to streamline operations and automate whatever manual work we did last month.



We are a small team with high standards. People here do what they said they would do, say when something has gone wrong, and are direct in their communications. If you need to be constantly hand-held or chased, this will not be a good fit. 



If you like owning a stack and making it better, we would like to hear from you.





--- WHAT YOU WILL DO --- 



• Build and maintain weekly posts and pages in WordPress using Bricks, including ACF fields and custom PHP snippets.

• Build, manage and optimize funnels and landing pages end-to-end in GoHighLevel and ClickFunnels 2.0, handling everything from layout to tracking.

• Implement structured data and technical SEO across the sites.

• Load and schedule approved
 sequences and campaigns.

• Build, manage, and optimize automations in Zapier, Pabbly, and GoHighLevel.

• Set up and debug tracking in GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta, and LinkedIn.

• Deploy page-level split tests and conversion experiments with accurate tracking.

• Build and maintain weekly reporting dashboards.

• Maintain site health: monitor speed, redirects, broken links, backups, and staging environments.

• Monitor systems daily to catch failures, and either fix them or escalate appropriately.

• Leverage AI tools to accelerate bulk manual work like data migrations and site-wide updates.

• Proactively identify and propose better tools and automation strategies.

• Write standard operating procedures (SOPs) for everything you build.





--- WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR ---



REQUIRED



• Solid WordPress experience with a visual builder (Bricks preferred; Elementor or Oxygen acceptable).

• Comfortable editing PHP snippets.

• GoHighLevel and ClickFunnels 2.0 experience: funnels, workflows, products, contracts, forms, surveys, pipelines, and calendars.

• Proficiency in at least one automation platform: Pabbly, Make, or Zapier.

• Ability to set up and debug GA4 and Google Tag Manager.

• Basic visual competence: you can lay out a professional page, apply brand colors, and place images. A dedicated design team will support you with custom graphics.

• Excellent written English.

• Problem-solving mindset: you diagnose before you escalate, bringing a proposed fix rather than just a problem.

• Independent execution: you are accountable to outcomes, not hours logged.

• Habitual documentation of your work.



BONUS



• Strong graphic design skills.

• Experience with Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) or Rank Math.

• Track record of conversion rate optimization and split testing.

• Proven use of AI tools to accelerate repetitive workflows.

• Technical SEO experience, specifically structured data and schema markup.





--- WHO YOU ARE ---



• Data-driven: You form hypotheses and then test them, and you change your position when the data disagrees.

• High personal standards: You treat your work as a craft and consistently push yourself to deliver excellent results.

• A clear communicator: You write English concisely and proactively on Slack, keeping the team aligned without needing to be chased for updates.

• Eager to grow: You are naturally curious, love leveraging AI to work faster, and actively seek ways to improve existing systems.

• Team-focused: You take ownership of your mistakes, share credit for wins, and approach your work with a mindset of serving the broader team goals.





--- SCHEDULE AND TERMS ---



• Your working hours are highly flexible. The only fixed requirement is a few hours overlapping with morning Pacific Time for two to three live sessions a week, which we will schedule together. 

• Because you manage your own time, proactive daily communication on Slack is required to stay aligned on updates and ongoing discussions.

• This role is focused entirely on one company and one stack. There is no agency churn and no juggling multiple clients.





--- COMPENSATION ---



US$750 per month, paid monthly.





--- HOW TO APPLY ---



Please reply with the following: 



1. Two or three examples of funnels or sites you built end-to-end, noting your specific contribution to each.



2. A short description of a workflow you built or improved without being asked.



3. Details on your GoHighLevel experience (what you have built and which parts of the platform you use most).



--- Note: Applications without work examples will not be reviewed.

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Fast-Growing Camera Brand — Long-Term
description:
IMPORTANT: To apply, please fill out this short application form:







Applications without a completed form will not be considered.



We’re a fast-growing brand selling cameras and camera products.



We’re currently expanding our creative team and looking for multiple talented short-form video editors to work with us long-term.



This is not a one-off project.



We want to build a small, selected group of great editors who understand performance creative, storytelling, pacing and how to create ads that actually keep people watching / convert.



What you'll be working on



You’ll mainly create short-form video ads for Meta, Instagram and TikTok.



We already have a large amount of existing content, including:



UGC footage

Product footage

Lifestyle footage

Existing winning ads

Scripts and creative concepts



However, we also expect you to be comfortable creating additional AI-generated footage when needed based on our scripts and concepts.



Experience with tools such as Google Veo, Google Flow, Nano Banana, Higgsfield, Kling or similar AI video workflows is a big plus.



Volume



We are looking for approximately:



15 videos per week



If the collaboration works well, there will be consistent long-term work.



Who we're looking for



We don't work with just anyone.



We collaborate with a selected group of editors who each bring something special to our creative team.



You should:



Understand short-form performance ads

Be strong at hooks, pacing and retention

Know how to make content feel native instead of overly polished or “advertisement-like”

Have experience editing 9:16 content

Be comfortable working from scripts and creative briefs

Be able to use AI to create missing shots or completely new scenes

Deliver consistently and on time



Experience working with e-commerce brands is highly preferred.



Important



We want to see the best short-form AI videos/ads you have personally created and edited.



If your work stands out, we’ll invite you to the next step.



We’re looking for editors we can work with for months or potentially years — not just for one project.

title: Appointment Setter / CRM Manager — Aesthetics Clinic (UK Hours) | Vital Glow
description:
Appointment Setter / CRM Manager — Aesthetics Clinic (UK Hours) | Vital Glow



Vital Glow is a growing, nurse-led medical aesthetics and IV therapy clinic in the UK. We're hiring one reliable, phone-confident Appointment Setter to keep our pipeline full, book qualified consultations, and keep our CRM clean.



This is a phone-heavy role. If you're not comfortable making outbound calls and speaking warmly with UK-based enquirers every day, this isn't the role for you. Your core job is simple to describe and hard to do well: call leads, revive old ones, book qualified consultations, and keep GoHighLevel accurate.



Because we're a regulated medical clinic, you'll represent us professionally and with care — you'll book consultations (not treatments), reassure nervous first-timers, and never give clinical advice. Warmth and trust matter more than hard selling here.



What you'll own:



Calling & setting: Call new and aged leads daily, qualify them against our criteria, and book qualified consultations directly into our calendar.

Lead reactivation: Systematically work through cold leads, no-shows, and stalled conversations by phone, WhatsApp and SMS — no lead left without a next step.

CRM management: Keep GoHighLevel pipelines, tags, stages, and notes updated immediately after every touch. Maintain a clean, actionable pipeline.

Follow-up & show-rate: Confirm booked consultations and follow up to reduce no-shows.

Ad hoc support: Light reporting, follow-up sequences, and helping our systems stay consistent.

Rebooking current clients and ensuring they repeat treatments. 



You must have:



Proven experience as an Appointment Setter, Sales VA, or Cold Caller (min. 1 year).

Strong spoken English and a confident, warm, professional phone presence — comfortable handling objections without being pushy.

Hands-on GoHighLevel experience (or a close equivalent: HubSpot, Keap, ActiveCampaign).

Reliable computer, fast internet, and a noise-cancelling headset (home-based role).

Willingness to work UK business hours.



Nice to have: Meta Ads familiarity, automation tools (Zapier, n8n), experience in aesthetics, wellness, healthcare, or beauty businesses.



Location: Philippines only. Home-based.



Compensation: [45,000-55,000]/month base (depending on experience) + commission per qualified consultation that shows. Guaranteed on-time monthly payment. Paid leave. Long-term role with room to grow into a lead manager position for strong performers.



To apply — read carefully (applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed):



Start your application with the phrase "Glow with Vital" so we know you read this.

In 2–3 sentences, describe your experience with outbound calling and lead reactivation specifically.

Tell us which CRM(s) you've used and what you did inside them.

Record a 60-second voice note introducing yourself, then pretending you're calling someone who enquired about an aesthetic treatment two weeks ago but never booked a consultation. Treat it like a real, warm call opener — reassuring, not salesy.

title: Minecraft Story Video Creator & Editor – Gameplay + Recording + Full Production | Long-Term

"Blue Ocean"

title: Booking Coordinator and Virtual Assistant
description:
Important Work Environment Disclosure



Please read this section carefully before applying. We want to be transparent about what this role is like so that there are no surprises after you are hired.



This is a high-volume, fast-paced position. The workload can be extremely heavy, and there may be times when a large amount of information, messages, bookings, and instructions come in at once.



You may need to:



• Read and process a lot of information quickly

• Manage multiple conversations at the same time

• Switch between different tasks throughout your shift

• Remember and follow multiple instructions

• Prioritize urgent requests

• Keep track of details while working quickly

• Learn new procedures and systems as they are introduced

• Handle periods of very high activity without becoming overwhelmed



Regular Feedback & Corrections



Regular feedback is a normal and important part of this role.



Because we work quickly and handle a high volume of clients and bookings, you will receive frequent feedback, corrections, and reminders, especially while you are learning the position.



We may ask you to change how you are completing a task, correct an error, follow a different procedure, or improve your response time.



This is not meant to be personal or negative. Our goal is to help you learn the role, improve your performance, and maintain a high standard of service.



You should be comfortable receiving constructive feedback and making adjustments quickly.



If you prefer a role with very little feedback, few corrections, or minimal oversight, this position may not be the right fit for you.



A Lot of Information Will Be Introduced



There is a lot to learn in this position. During training and throughout your time with us, you will receive new information, procedures, scripts, systems, and instructions.



You are not expected to remember everything immediately.



However, we do expect you to:



• Take notes

• Review training materials

• Ask questions when something is unclear

• Make a genuine effort to remember instructions

• Apply previous feedback to future situations

• Become more independent as you gain experience



We understand that learning takes time. What matters most to us is that you are willing to learn, responsive to feedback, and consistently improving.



Please Apply If You Enjoy:



• Fast-paced work

• Staying busy throughout your shift

• Learning new things

• Solving problems

• Multitasking

• Receiving feedback and improving

• Taking initiative

• Working as part of a team

• Having a role where every day can be different



We are looking for someone who enjoys being busy and takes pride in keeping things organized, even when there is a lot happening at once.

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.

Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Assistant Project Manager – Construction
description:
We are a U.S.-based construction company managing residential renovation, rehab, turn, and construction projects across multiple markets.



We are looking for a highly organized **Project Manager Assistant** based in the Philippines to support our Project Managers with the day-to-day administrative and coordination work required to keep projects moving.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. You will work directly with construction Project Managers and will be responsible for tracking projects, communicating with subcontractors and vendors, organizing documentation, following up on outstanding items, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Your job is to help the Project Manager stay ahead of every project.



## Key Responsibilities



### Project Tracking & Follow-Up



* Maintain an up-to-date list of every active project and its current status.

* Track project start dates, completion dates, deadlines, inspections, material deliveries, and outstanding items.

* Review each active project daily and identify anything that is overdue or could delay completion.

* Follow up with Project Managers, subcontractors, vendors, and suppliers on outstanding items.

* Maintain punch lists and track items through completion.

* Track client change requests and change orders.

* Flag projects that are behind schedule or have unresolved issues.

* Prepare daily and weekly project status reports for management.



### Subcontractor & Vendor Coordination



* Contact subcontractors to confirm scheduling and availability.

* Follow up with subcontractors for estimates and pricing.

* Confirm scheduled crews before work begins.

* Follow up on incomplete work and punch-list items.

* Collect invoices, estimates, receipts, photos, and other required documentation.

* Maintain subcontractor contact information and vendor records.

* Help locate new subcontractors and vendors when needed.

* Track which subcontractors are assigned to each project.



### Materials & Purchasing



* Assist Project Managers with creating material lists.

* Request pricing and availability from suppliers.

* Coordinate material orders and deliveries.

* Confirm deliveries with the Project Manager or subcontractor.

* Track missing, damaged, or delayed materials.

* Maintain receipts and purchasing documentation by project.



### Project Documentation



* Organize project photos and documentation.

* Review project management systems daily for missing information.

* Make sure required before, progress, and completion photos are uploaded.

* Organize scopes of work, estimates, change orders, invoices, inspection reports, permits, and other project documents.

* Keep project folders and records organized.

* Update project management software with current project information.



### Client & Internal Communication



* Draft project updates for clients.

* Help Project Managers respond to routine client questions.

* Track client requests and make sure they are assigned and completed.

* Maintain written records of important project decisions.

* Prepare summaries of outstanding issues requiring Project Manager or management attention.



### Inspections & Closeout



* Help schedule inspections when required.

* Track inspection results and corrections.

* Maintain project punch lists.

* Confirm required completion photos and documents have been received.

* Help assemble project closeout documentation.

* Make sure projects are administratively ready for final invoicing.



## Daily Expectations



Every morning, the Project Manager Assistant should know:



* What projects are active.

* What work is scheduled today.

* Which subcontractors are supposed to be onsite.

* What materials are being delivered.

* What inspections are scheduled.

* What projects are behind schedule.

* What information or pricing we are waiting on.

* What client requests remain outstanding.

* What projects are approaching completion.



At the end of each day, project statuses should be updated so management has an accurate picture of every active job.



## What the Project Manager Assistant Does NOT Do



The Project Manager remains responsible for field execution, subcontractor performance, workmanship, jobsite decisions, construction decisions, and overall project completion.



The Project Manager Assistant handles the **coordination, tracking, documentation, and follow-up** that allows the Project Manager to focus on managing construction.



## Performance Expectations / KPIs



Performance will be measured based on:



* 100% of active projects updated daily.

* Scheduled subcontractors confirmed before their scheduled work.

* Outstanding items followed up on daily.

* Estimates and requested vendor pricing followed up on within 24 hours.

* Client requests documented and assigned promptly.

* Missing project photos/documentation identified within 24 hours.

* Punch-list items actively tracked until completion.

* Project delays escalated before they become major problems.

* Project closeout documentation completed promptly.

* Project Manager receives a clear list of priorities and outstanding items each day.



## Ideal Candidate



You may be a good fit if you:



* Have experience supporting construction, property management, maintenance, real estate, or project management operations.

* Are extremely organized and detail-oriented.

* Are comfortable following up repeatedly until something is completed.

* Communicate professionally in written and spoken English.

* Can manage many projects and tasks simultaneously.

* Are comfortable calling and texting U.S.-based subcontractors and vendors.

* Are proactive and do not wait to be told about every follow-up.

* Understand deadlines and know when an issue needs to be escalated.

* Are comfortable learning construction terminology.

* Are proficient with spreadsheets,
, cloud-based software, and project management systems.



Construction experience is strongly preferred.



## Schedule



Full-time position working primarily during U.S. business hours.



Because this role communicates directly with U.S.-based Project Managers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients, the candidate must be comfortable working a schedule that overlaps significantly with U.S. Eastern/Central time.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful Project Manager Assistant makes the Project Manager significantly more productive.



The PM should not have to remember to chase a subcontractor for a quote, check whether photos were uploaded, remember an inspection date, search for a missing invoice, or repeatedly check whether a punch-list item was completed.



The assistant owns the administrative follow-through.



When something needs to happen, it is tracked.



When someone owes us something, it is followed up on.



When something is late, it is escalated.



When a project changes, the project records are updated.



The objective is simple: **keep every project organized and moving toward completion.**

title: Client Growth Manager
description:
Client Growth Manager — DTC Apparel Marketing Agency (US Hours)



PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE DESCRIPTION OR YOU WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED 



Full-time | Remote | Must overlap US Eastern hours (approx. 9am–1pm ET / 9pm–1am PH minimum)



About us

We're a US-based marketing agency that works exclusively with direct-to-consumer clothing and apparel brands. We run paid ads (Meta and Google),
/SMS, ambassador programs, and UGC as one integrated growth system. We are growing and need a sharp, organized person to own our client relationships and keep every account on track.



What you'll do

You are the person who keeps each apparel client's growth on schedule and their paid ads profitable, week after week. Specifically:



- **Run the weekly review.** Pull each client's Meta and Google numbers, compare against their breakeven, and assess whether the account is healthy. Flag problems early.

- **Own the drop calendar.** Apparel brands launch product "drops." You make sure
/SMS flows are queued, creative is ready, and the media buyer has what they need, so nothing slips before a launch.

- **Be the client's main point of contact.** Weekly check-ins, clear updates, answering questions, handling the small things so they never become big things.

- **Check the media buyer's work.** You won't build campaigns, but you must catch when spend is off or performance is slipping and raise it before the client notices.

- **Escalate the right things.** Handle routine calls yourself using our playbook. Bring the real judgment calls to the founder, packaged and ready to d
.



You must have

- **Strong English, written and spoken.** You'll be on client calls and writing client updates. Both need to be crisp. This is non-negotiable.

- **Comfort with ad numbers.** You can read a week of Meta data, understand a breakeven number, and check a buyer's work. You don't need to be a world-class buyer, but you must speak their language.

- **DTC apparel experience.** You already understand clothing brand funnels, offers, drop calendars, and
 flows. We are not teaching the category from scratch.

- **Great judgment.** You know the difference between a decision you can make and one that needs to go up the chain. You ask instead of guessing.

- **Coordinator instinct.** Organized, calendar-driven, and you follow up without being chased.



**Nice to have**

- Hands-on Meta or Google Ads experience

- Direct experience inside or with a DTC clothing brand

- Experience managing a small team



**Hours & pay**

- Full-time, must reliably overlap US Eastern business hours (this is a hard requirement, not occasional)

- Pay range: **$650–$1,250/month** depending on experience and ad literacy



**How to apply**

1. Start your message with the word **APPAREL** so I know you read this.

2. Tell me about one DTC clothing brand you've worked with and what you specifically did.

3. Answer this: *A client wants to kill a campaign in the middle of a drop. The last 7 days of Meta data are below breakeven, but the drop launches in 3 days. What do you do?*



Applications that skip the question or give a generic answer will not be considered.

title: Short-Form Video Editor, Reels + Graphics
description:
ABOUT US:

Havenroll is a marketing agency serving private Christian schools and other faith-based clients. We help schools reach and enroll families who align with their mission. We also handle video and social media for a handful of churches, nonprofits, and small businesses.



YOUR ROLE:

You are the production end of our content pipeline. Raw footage and a completed brief come to you, and finished video and graphics go back out. You will not set strategy, d
 what gets produced, or run shoots. Your responsibility is execution: correct pacing, clean captions, accurate brand application, and delivery on schedule.



The majority of the work is short-form video, primarily reels cut from footage shot by us or our clients. The remainder is still graphics and templated Meta carousels.



A note on client mix: most of our current clients are churches, nonprofits, and small businesses. Christian schools are our focus going forward, and school work takes priority in the production queue. Expect the mix to shift over the next year.



RESPONSIBILITIES: 

1. Short-form video editing. Cut reels from supplied footage and written briefs. Tight pacing, clean and accurate captions, music synced, and a hook that lands within the first two seconds. Turn around first drafts quickly and handle revisions without friction.



2. Graphic design. Build still graphics and multi-image Meta carousels from templates. Correct alignment, correct dimensions, no errors.



3. Brand consistency. Each client has a documented brand kit covering fonts, colors, logos, and tone. You are expected to work inside it without reminders, and to help maintain and extend our reusable template library.



4. Throughput and communication. Work from our Asana board. Pick up briefs, meet deadlines, post clean first drafts, and act on revision notes as given. Raise unclear briefs or at-risk deadlines the same day you identify them rather than after the deadline passes. This last point carries real weight in how we evaluate performance.



SCHEDULE:

This role requires full overlap with our business hours. Your working hours must fall entirely within 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. 



REQUIREMENTS:

- Availability for 30 hours per week, starting immediately

- Working hours entirely within 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central, Monday through Friday

- Clear, professional written and spoken English

- A computer and internet connection capable of sustained video editing

- Comfort working in a Christian, faith-based context. You do not need to be religious, but our clients are, and the work centers on their mission

- Demonstrated ability to produce consistent volume on deadline without supervision



TOOLS:

- Asana for briefs, deadlines, and tracking. 

- Canva for graphics and carousels, since our templates need to remain editable by the whole team. 

- Google Workspace. 

- Loom for training and progress updates. 

- Slack for daily communication.



For video, use whichever editor you work best in: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or CapCut. We do not require a specific application. DaVinci Resolve is a plus, as is Photoshop, but neither is required.



We will train you on Asana and our internal workflows. Editing ability, speed, and reliability matter more to us than familiarity with any particular tool.



RATE AND PROGRESSION:

Starting rate: $8 to $10 per hour, depending on experience.



The first 30 days is a paid trial period. We train you on our clients, brand kits, and editing standards. By the end of it you should be able to take a brief and footage and deliver a finished, on-brand piece with minimal direction. At day 30 both parties d
 whether to continue.



After that, you receive a color-coded performance scorecard every one to two weeks.



Hours begin at 30 per week and grow toward full-time as we add school clients.



HIRING PROCESS:

Strong proposals move to a short paid task. You receive real footage from a current client, the actual brief, and that client's brand kit, and produce one reel of 30 to 40 seconds within 48 hours. This pays $25 flat regardless of outcome. We then send one round of revision notes to see how you work with direction.



No unpaid test work at any stage.



HOW TO APPLY:

Answer the following screening questions, and include a link to your portfolio. If you worked from someone else's footage or brief, let us know.



1. Link two reels and one graphic/thumbnail/carousel you made yourself. One line on each describing what you specifically did.



2. What program(s) do you edit in, and how long have you been using it?



3. How many short-form videos did you deliver in your busiest week?



4. Walk me through your process from receiving raw footage to delivering a finished reel. Include any tools, presets, or shortcuts you use to move faster.



5. Describe a time you got a brief or instruction you couldn't complete as written. What did you do?

title: WordPress Web Specialist (Part-Time, Full Time Potential)
description:
About Us

We are building Reach Repair Marketing. A local search marketing company designed to help businesses reach their customers consistently and professionally by boosting their online visibility. We are looking for a talented, proactive Web Specialist to join our small, agile team. This role starts as a part-time position (10-20 hours a week) focused on building our own agency website. 



This role has the potential to scale into more hours and eventually a full-time position as we transition to building and managing websites for our clients. The Web Specialist will have the opportunity to help shape our web division. 



Must be willing to work/communicate during our ET core operating hours (9am ET - 5pm ET). 

Must be willing to clock in/ clock out to track your hours worked for accurate payment. 

C1 or C2 English level proficiency required. 



The Role & Responsibilities

Your initial project will be designing and developing the Reach Repair Marketing company website. Moving forward, you will:

- Design, develop, and launch high-converting websites for local service-based businesses.

- Edit, update, maintain, and optimize existing websites (both internal and client-facing).

- Ensure all sites are fast, mobile-responsive, visually stunning, and highly functional.

- Implement foundational technical, on-page SEO best practices during the build process.



What We Are Looking For (Requirements):

- A Solid Portfolio: You must have a portfolio of live websites or case studies demonstrating your design and development skills.

- Platform Expertise: Strong experience building in WordPress and managing technical aspects such as hosting, plugin updates, etc.

- UI/UX & Conversion Mindset: You do more than build pretty pages; you understand how user experience, layout, and structure drive conversions.

- White-Hat SEO & Google Ecosystem Knowledge: A strong grasp of SEO principles. Familiarity with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, page speed optimization, and Core Web Vitals is required.

- Eagle Eye for Detail: You spot alignment issues, broken links, and formatting errors before anyone else does.

- Communication & Teamwork: Great English communication skills. You are proactive, collaborative, and comfortable working in a close-knit, small team setting.

- Industry Savvy: Forward-thinking and eager to stay up-to-date with digital marketing, design trends, and algorithm changes.



Nice-to-Haves:

* Previous experience working with a digital marketing agency.

* Experience specific to local service-based business industries.



How to Apply

To apply, please send a message with the subject line: "Web Specialist for Reach Repair - [Your Name]" and include the following:

- A brief summary about you and your experience with WordPress.

- A link to your portfolio or 2–3 of your best live website examples.

title: Amazon PPC / Advertising Specialist
description:
Amazon PPC Specialist - Pax Distribution



We manage Amazon end-to-end for premium brands. You'd run the ad accounts day to day. Build the campaigns, read the data, kill what's not working, double down on what is.



This isn't a set-it-and-forget-it seat. We don't manage everything to one ACoS number and call it a day. Every campaign has a job, and the job d
 the metric. A rank-building campaign gets judged differently than a profitability one. If that made sense to you, keep reading. If it didn't, this isn't your role.



What you'd actually do





Build and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display across several brands

Structure campaigns so our own products don't bid against each other



Own the negative keyword work. This is where most people get lazy and it's where accounts quietly leak money

Read Search Query Performance and Brand Analytics, and tell me which terms we can actually win and which we can't

Know when to stop spending, not just when to spend



You're a fit if



You think in terms of what a campaign is for, not just its ACoS

You'll tell me a keyword isn't worth it even when it looks good on paper

You get that sometimes the fix is the reviews or the listing, not more ad spend

You treat a budget as a ceiling, not a quota to hit



You're not a fit if



You manage everything to one blended ACoS target

You think more spend is always the answer

You need to be told what to do every day

You can't explain why you made a bid change

title: Lead Full Stack Engineer
description:
DTiQ is looking for a hands-on Lead Full Stack Engineer to join our Drive-Thru engineering team in Melbourne.

Our Drive-Thru platform provides quick-service restaurant operators across the globe with real-time speed-of-service information and operational insights. The technology spans Angular applications, Java services, containers, Linux-based edge devices, IoT messaging, computer vision and cloud-connected systems.

This role goes beyond typical web development. It would suit a senior engineer who enjoys hands-on software development, solving complex technical problems and helping other engineers make sound technical decisions.

You will work across the full product stack, from user interfaces and backend services through to Linux devices, messaging and network communications.

What you will do

• Design and develop front-end applications using Angular and TypeScript.

• Build backend services, APIs and integrations using Java and Spring Boot.

• Develop and maintain software running on Linux-based edge devices.

• Implement communication between devices, applications and services using MQTT, REST APIs and event-driven patterns.

• Build, deploy and troubleshoot containerised applications using Docker.

• Investigate and resolve complex issues across applications, Linux systems, devices, messaging and networks.

• Lead the technical design and delivery of major product improvements.

• Review code and designs, mentor engineers and improve engineering practices.

• Improve system reliability, diagnostics, deployment and failure recovery.

• Work closely with Product, QA, Computer Vision, Support and Infrastructure teams.

What you will bring

Core requirements

• Strong commercial experience across front-end and backend software development.

• Strong experience with modern Angular, preferably Angular 17 or later.

• Strong TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS skills.

• Experience with standalone components, signals, reactive programming and state management.

• Strong commercial experience with Java and Spring Boot.

• Experience designing maintainable backend services, REST APIs, asynchronous processing and application integrations.

• Strong practical Linux skills, including shell scripting.

• Experience with Docker and containerised applications.

• Experience with MQTT or comparable messaging technologies.

• Sound networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, ports, routing and firewalls.

• Experience working with distributed systems, edge devices or intermittently connected environments.

• Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.

• Experience with Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Desirable experience

Experience in any of the following would be valuable:

• IoT or edge-computing platforms.

• Strong systems thinking.

• Virtual machines and virtualisation.

• Computer vision.

• Hardware or peripheral-device integration.

• Retail, hospitality or quick-service restaurant technology.

• AWS and hybrid edge-to-cloud environments.

• Monitoring, observability or configuration-management tools.

Why join DTiQ

• Work on a globally deployed product operating in real customer environments.

• Take ownership across applications, services and edge devices.

• Influence the technical direction and modernisation of the Drive-Thru platform.

• Solve engineering problems that extend beyond conventional web development.

• Work directly with the Head of Engineering and contribute to key technical decisions.

• Remain hands-on while growing your influence as a technical leader.

About you

You are a senior engineer who enjoys building software, solving difficult technical problems and helping other engineers produce strong outcomes.

You communicate clearly, take ownership and make sound technical decisions without adding unnecessary complexity.

title: Junior Virtual Assistant
description:
At Enlightening Motherhood, we help parents of neurodivergent children build emotional resilience and stronger family relationships through online classes, coaching, and education. We're a small, heart-centered team doing big things — and we're growing.



We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented VA who takes ownership of their work and loves bringing order to a creative, mission-driven space.

_______



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



• Video editing and clipping using Riverside/Capcut

• Creating social media graphics and thumbnails in Canva

• Scheduling and repurposing content across platforms

• Uploading and organizing course content in Thrivecart and Skool

• Supporting general admin and operations as the business grows



---



TOOLS WE USE

Descript · Canva · Metricool · Google Workspace · Slack · Asana · Thrivecart · Heartbeat · Flodesk · WordPress · ChatGPT · Zoom



We don't expect you to know all of them. We do expect you to figure them out.



_______________



THIS IS FOR YOU IF



You do what you say you will do

You message ahead of time — not after — if something comes up

When you hit a tech problem, you search, try, and figure it out before asking for help

You check your work before submitting it

You catch mistakes — yours or a teammate's — and fix them or flag them kindly

You speak up when you have a question, a struggle, or an idea

You are honest, even when it's uncomfortable

You are kind, even when you're correcting someone



This is NOT the right role for you if:



You say yes but then don’t follow through. You agree to be available and then go quiet without any message.

You avoid a task when it feels hard or overwhelming instead of asking for help.

You get stuck on a tech problem and instead of trying to figure it out yourself, you stop working and wait for someone to solve it for you.

You rush through work and don’t check it before submitting.

When you spot a mistake, yours or someone else’s, you ignore it instead of fixing it.

You don’t speak up when you notice something needs attention, or you struggle to point things out kindly.

You keep your struggles to yourself instead of communicating them.

You notify us last minute that you are unavailable.

You’ll be double-tasking while working—simultaneously taking care of kids, prepping meals, or managing other responsibilities.

You skip parts of instructions or move too fast and miss important details.



If any of that sounds like you, please don’t apply. We mean that kindly—this just isn’t the right fit, and that’s okay. We would rather both of us find the right match than waste each other’s time.

_____________________



A few things that matter to us that you won’t find in most job posts



We serve a community of parents who are already exhausted. They come to us because their neurodivergent kids deserve better tools—and so do they. That means the work we do has to be done with care. A task that gets rushed or half-finished doesn’t just create a to-do list problem, it affects real families.



Our team moves fast, thinks creatively, and sometimes needs people who can catch what falls through the cracks without being asked. If you need every detail spelled out before you can move, this won’t feel good for either of us. But if you love bringing order to a creative, mission-driven space and can think on your feet, you will thrive here.



We also use a lot of tools. Not because we love complexity, but because we’re a small team doing big things. We don’t expect you to know all of them. We do expect you to figure them out without needing us to walk you through every step.



We are not a difficult team to work with. We are supportive, we celebrate good work, and we want you to succeed. But we need someone we can trust completely, because we will not be checking on you every hour. You will have real responsibility here, and we want you to own it.

_____________________



Growth of this role



This contract begins part-time at 5–10 hours per week. We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us. As the business expands and you prove yourself in this role, we anticipate this engagement increasing in both scope and hours with the potential to grow toward 20+ hours per week and beyond as you develop your expertise and we scale.



We are genuinely looking for a long-term hire. We want to invest in someone who is invested in us. If you are looking for a genuine opportunity to help build something meaningful while growing your own skills, this may be exactly what you’re looking for.



This role requires someone who enjoys bringing order to operations, taking ownership, and continuously improving how things work. If you prefer simply completing assigned tasks rather than improving how things work, this role will likely feel frustrating.



_________________



AVAILABILITY

Monday–Friday with at least 1–2 hours of overlap with US Mountain Time (MST). Full focus while working — no double-tasking.



PAY

$___/hour USD (please include your rate when you apply in the Google Form)





HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send a simple reply. COMPLETE THE FULL APPLICATION HERE: 





We read every application personally and are looking for a long-term fit. If this sounds like you, we'd genuinely love to meet you.



Warmly,

Emily

Enlightening Motherhood

title: Virtual Assistant – Product & Wholesale Supplier Research UPDATED
description:
We are a Canadian product-based business looking for one reliable Virtual Assistant to research potential resale products and identify wholesale or online-arbitrage suppliers where those products may be purchased.



The main purpose of this position is to create an organized spreadsheet of potentially viable product leads that meet our initial research criteria.



Main Responsibilities

Find potential resale products that meet the research criteria provided

Locate Canadian wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, authorized dealers, retailers, and online-arbitrage sources

Search supplier websites, wholesale catalogs, brand websites, retail websites, and approved marketplaces

Confirm that the exact product is available from the identified supplier

Match products accurately using the UPC, model number, size, quantity, package count, scent, colour, or variation

Record all product and supplier information in a provided spreadsheet

Include direct links to the supplier’s product page and the matching comparison listing

Record the current supplier price

Identify minimum order quantities, case quantities, membership requirements, and wholesale-account requirements

Confirm whether the supplier is located in Canada or ships to Canada

Note whether the supplier appears legitimate and established

Record visible concerns, restrictions, missing information, or unusual requirements

Review supplier catalogs for additional product leads

Follow the written product-research criteria exactly

Avoid submitting products that clearly do not meet the initial criteria

Ask questions when unsure rather than guessing



Product Lead Criteria



Clear product-research requirements will be provided. These may include:



Approved product categories

Minimum or maximum selling-price ranges

Minimum demand or sales indicators

Seller-count requirements

Brands or product types to avoid

Supplier-location requirements

Products that must not be sold directly by certain major retailers

Package-size and variation-matching requirements

Product-condition and authenticity requirements



The VA’s responsibility is to find products that appear to meet these initial criteria and enter them accurately into the spreadsheet for review.



Spreadsheet Information



For each potential product lead, the VA may be required to enter:



Product name

Brand

UPC, SKU, or model number

Size, quantity, package count, or variation

Product category

Supplier name

Supplier type

Supplier country

Current purchase price

Case quantity or minimum order

Supplier product link

Matching comparison-product link

Current listed selling price

Number of visible sellers

Whether a specified major retailer appears to sell the product

Wholesale-account or membership requirement

Shipping availability to Canada

Date researched

Notes, concerns, or missing information



Accuracy is more important than submitting a large number of leads.



Ideal Applicant



The ideal applicant:



Has experience with product research, supplier research, wholesale sourcing, online arbitrage, or e-commerce

Has strong online research skills

Is comfortable using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel

Pays close attention to UPCs, model numbers, package quantities, sizes, and product variations

Understands the difference between manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers, retailers, and marketplaces

Can identify suspicious websites and poor-quality supplier leads

Can follow detailed written criteria without changing the requirements

Does not guess or invent missing information

Communicates clearly when a product or supplier requires further review

Has reliable internet and good written English

Is consistently available for approximately 10 hours per week 

Note:  You are able to have another FT/PT job.  This would be supplemental income.



Paid Training, product criteria, spreadsheets, and research templates will be provided.



Pay



$5-$6 CAD per hour  - Please do not apply if you are looking for higher base pay.  This is repetitive data-entry.



This is one ongoing part-time position for approximately 10 hours per week. 

Additional hours are not guaranteed.  

This position is best suited to someone seeking consistent supplemental part-time income and who can reliably commit approximately 10 hours each week (2 hours daily for 5 days)



Selected applicants may first be offered a small paid research trial. Continued work will depend on accuracy, reliability, attention to detail, and the quality of the product leads submitted.



Application Instructions



Put the word SEAWORLD at the beginning of your application subject line.



Please answer the following questions in writing without the use of AI:



Have you previously researched products or suppliers?

Have you worked with wholesale sourcing or online arbitrage?

How would you make sure you found the exact same product and package size?

What information would you record for a potential product lead?

How would you check whether a supplier appears legitimate?

What experience do you have with Google Sheets or Excel?

Are you available for approximately 10 hours every week (2 hours daily for 5 days)?

Are you willing to complete a paid product-research trial?

Are you okay with the starting training wage of $5/hour CAD?



Pick a product.  Find who sells it and who manufacturers it. Send me a Loom video link, say your name, show me the product, then show me your research skills in less than 5 minutes.  You can use any tool to help you.



To be considered, please follow all application instructions carefully. Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be reviewed.

title: Customer Support & Documentation Specialist
description:
ABOUT US



We are a rental management platform used by RV rental businesses across the United States to run their entire operation — reservations, payments, security deposits, fleet maintenance, and customer communication. We were built by people who ran an RV rental company for 14 years, so we know exactly what our customers are dealing with when something goes wrong in the middle of a busy weekend.



Several members of our team are based in the Philippines, and they have become essential to how this company runs. Our QA team, who you would work with every day, is there. Our lead developer works in the same timezone you do. This is not our first  hire from the Philippines and we are not experimenting.



We are a small, profitable software company building for the long term. Our software is new, growing quickly, and used by real businesses with real money moving through it. That makes the work genuinely interesting, and it means there is always something new to learn.





THE ROLE



Full-time (40 hrs/week), Philippine business hours, fully remote from anywhere in the Philippines. Compensation is PHP 45,000 - 55,000 per month depending on experience, employed through our Employer of Record, including 13th month pay, statutory contributions, and Philippine public holidays. You will report to the two founders directly.  



You will learn our software thoroughly by writing the documentation for it, and use that knowledge to help our customers when they need it.



Roughly 80% of what makes someone great at this comes down to two things: being an excellent writer and documenter, and genuinely caring about the person on the other end of the message. If you bring those and a willingness to learn, we will teach you the rest.



DOCUMENTATION — your main work, especially in the first months:



- Work alongside our QA team to document every page and workflow in the application, and maintain the step-by-step checklists QA uses when testing

- Create customer-facing help content: written guides, annotated screenshots, short screen-recorded videos

- Keep documentation current as the product changes — we release new features frequently

- Contribute to in-app help content and product release announcements



CUSTOMER SUPPORT — growing over time:



All of your customer contact is in writing. There is no phone work in this role; the rare call that is needed is handled by our US-based team.



- Read customer
s and figure out what they are actually asking, which is often not what they wrote

- Reproduce reported problems on our test environment and write up clear, complete descriptions of what you found

- Log defects in Linear (our issue tracker) with steps to reproduce, expected result, and actual result

- Answer customers directly when the software is working correctly and they simply need guidance



How escalation works: you try to reproduce the problem first, with help from our QA team — they are your day-to-day colleagues, they know the product deeply, and they share your timezone. If you cannot get to the bottom of it, or it needs a code-level answer, then you go to the founders. You are not expected to solve everything alone — you are expected to arrive with clear, complete information.





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Excellent written English. Most of your work is writing — to customers, in documentation, in defect reports. This is the single most important requirement of the job.

- Demonstrable writing or documentation experience: technical documentation, help centers, user guides, training materials, or similar. We would love to see examples.

- Genuine patience and empathy. Customers contact us when something is not working, often on a busy day when stress is high.

- Comfort with software. You explore a new application until you understand it, rather than waiting to be shown.

- The ability to work independently and communicate clearly in writing, we often work asynchronously. 

- A quiet, reliable work-from-home setup with dependable internet and space to record clear audio and video. Our whole team works remotely; we have no office in the Philippines. If your internet often goes down, or your power often goes out, this role is not for you.



Helpful but not required: software QA or testing experience; Linear, Jira, or a similar issue tracker; a help center tool (Intercom, HelpScout, Zendesk, Notion); video capture and editing (Loom, ScreenPal, Camtasia); exposure to booking, reservation, or payment software.





YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS AND BEYOND



You will spend roughly the first month learning the product by documenting it — working closely with our QA team, going page by page through the application, and asking a lot of questions. This is expected and welcome. From there you will begin shadowing real customer issues, and by around month three you will handle customer requests directly with review and support, while documentation remains a core part of your week.



This role is the foundation of our support function and we expect it to grow — owning our help center, contributing to customer onboarding, and mentoring future support hires as the team expands. We are looking for someone who wants to be with us for years, not months.





HOW TO APPLY



Please follow these instructions carefully. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed.



1. Start your message with the word SUNSEEKER so we know you read this posting fully.



2. Tell us about your writing. Attach or link to two samples of documentation or instructional writing you have produced. If your best work is under NDA, write something new — a one-page guide explaining any software feature you know well, to someone who has never used it. AI slop will disqualify you.  



3. Answer this scenario in your reply. You receive this
 from a customer:



"Hi — the deposit thing is broken again on one of our reservations. Customer is upset. Can you fix it? See attached."



(There is no attachment.)



In no more than 200 words: what do you do first, and what do you write back?



4. Tell us in two or three sentences why this kind of work appeals to you.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short paid documentation exercise: a two-minute screen recording of one workflow in our software, to be turned into a help article. This is the closest thing to the real job, and it is how we make our decision.
