title: Real Estate Virtual Assistant – Canadian Market (Paragon | BC | PST Hours)
description:
Real Estate Virtual Assistant — West Coast Living (Oakwyn Realty)

???? Remote | Full-Time | Philippine-Based Applicants | PST Hours (9 AM – 6 PM)





Who We Are

West Coast Living is a top-producing real estate team based in Vancouver, BC, operating under Oakwyn Realty. We specialize in residential resale, presale project marketing, rental property management, and developer-facing listing services. We are a fast-moving, highly collaborative team that takes pride in delivering an exceptional client experience and we hold ourselves to the same standard internally.

We are looking for a seasoned Real Estate Virtual Assistant who is ready to grow with us long-term. This is not a general admin role. This is a career opportunity for someone who knows Canadian real estate, speaks the language, understands the systems, and wants to be a real part of a professional team.





The Role

You will be embedded into our team,  attending meetings, communicating directly with agents and clients, and supporting the full transaction and marketing cycle. You will be relied on for accuracy, speed, professionalism, and initiative. If we succeed, you succeed. We believe in recognizing and rewarding the people who show up and deliver.





What You Will Do

Transaction & Listing Support

Prepare, organize, and track listing documents including MLS input forms, Schedule A/B addenda, and BCREA contracts

Enter and update listings on Paragon MLS — including photos, room measurements, strata details, and listing remarks

Manage document collection and completion checklists for active listings and buyer files

Follow up with lawyers, notaries, and conveyancers on missing items and completion milestones

Maintain accurate records in the team CRM (Reach)

Prepare showing feedback summaries and market update reports for clients



Administrative & Operations

Manage and organize Google Drive and Dropbox folders — naming conventions, version control, archiving

Draft and proofread client-facing
s, letters, and follow-up messages in a warm, professional tone

Prepare and manage web forms, online applications, and digital document submissions

Maintain team calendars, schedule showings, and coordinate appointments

Research properties, strata documents, title histories, and building profiles using online tools

Source and verify information from BC Assessment, Stratapress, Strata Plan Registry, and other public records

Support presale marketing files including unit trackers, price lists, and developer correspondence



Communication & Team Participation

Attend team meetings via Zoom or Google Meet (PST hours — 8 AM to 5 PM Monday to Friday)

Communicate responsively via WhatsApp and
 with team members and clients

Flag issues proactively — if something is missing, unclear, or time-sensitive, you speak up

Support the team lead with personal organization, task tracking, and project follow-up





What You Need to Bring

Non-Negotiable Requirements:

Minimum 2–3 years of real estate experience — either in a Canadian real estate office, with a Canadian real estate team, or supporting a Canadian broker or agent remotely

Solid working knowledge of Paragon MLS — including listing entry, status updates, and photo uploads

Familiarity with Canadian real estate forms, terminology, and transaction stages (Accepted Offer, Subject Removal, Completion, Possession)

Fluent written and spoken English — your
s, documents, and verbal communication must be professional and clear

Advanced skills in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail, Calendar) and Dropbox

Experience with web forms, digital documents, and e-signature tools (DocuSign or similar)

Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy under pressure

Reliable internet with minimum 25 Mbps upload/download — you must provide your speed test result

Backup internet plan for outages (mobile hotspot, nearby café, or generator) — tell us your plan



Strong Assets:

Experience with Canva for real estate marketing materials

Experience with presale project marketing or new development real estate

Familiarity with BC real estate specifics: strata, depreciation reports, Form B, PTT, FINTRAC

Proactive with technology — you don't just use tools, you suggest better ones

Experience supporting a team lead or broker in a client-facing real estate environment





Work Setup & Availability

This role works Vancouver time (Pacific Standard / Pacific Daylight Time) — Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. This is a hard requirement. Our clients and our market operate on this schedule, and you will be expected to be present and responsive during these hours.



We will ask you:

What is your current internet speed? (Please include a screenshot of a recent speed test from fast.com or speedtest.net)

Does your city/area experience frequent typhoons, power outages, or weather-related disruptions?

What is your backup plan if your primary internet goes down? (Mobile data, nearby café, generator — please describe)

We have experienced connectivity issues with previous VAs during weather events. We take this seriously and expect an honest, detailed answer.





Who Thrives on This Team

You are organized to the point that other people notice. You communicate before you're asked. You read a document all the way through before responding. You notice when something doesn't add up. You are proud of the quality of your work and you take ownership of your file like it's yours.



You want to build something — not just fill a role. You are looking for a team that will invest in you and give you room to grow. You are not looking for a side gig. You are looking for a career.





How to Apply — Read This Carefully

?? Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be reviewed.



Step 1 — Subject Line

Your subject line must read exactly: "WCL VA – [Your Name] – I Read the Whole Thing"

Any other subject line tells us you did not read this ad.



Step 2 — Your Application

In the body of your application, answer the following in order:

Briefly describe one real estate transaction or file you supported from start to finish — what was your role and what happened?

List every MLS system or real estate software you have used and how long you used each

What is the difference between Subject Removal and Completion in a BC real estate transaction? (Answer in your own words — do not Google this. If you know Canadian real estate, you know this.)

What is your internet speed and what is your backup plan for outages?

What city are you located in, and does it experience typhoons or storm-related outages? How do you handle this?

Tell us one tool or process you introduced in a previous role that made the team more efficient



Step 3 — Attachments

Your application must include:

Your updated resume (PDF preferred)

A portfolio or work sample — this can be a Canva design, a document you created, a spreadsheet you built, or any piece of work that shows us the quality of what you produce. If you do not have a portfolio, create a short sample — a listing description, a formatted table, a one-page summary of anything. This is your chance to show us how you work.

A screenshot of your internet speed test (from fast.com or speedtest.net)





Compensation & What We Offer

We pay for skill, experience, and reliability — not the lowest rate we can find. This is a long-term role and we compensate accordingly.



Base Rate:

$9.00 – $11.00 CDN per hour, full-time (40 hours/week), based on experience and demonstrated Canadian real estate knowledge.



What's Included:

Competitive base rate reviewed after your first 120 days

Performance-based increases — if the team grows, your compensation grows with it

13th month bonus (paid annually — this is a standard we honour without exception)

10 paid days off per year

A stable, long-term position with a professional and supportive team environment

Direct access to the team lead and agents — you are not working in isolation



We are not looking for the cheapest option. We are looking for the right person. If you bring the skills, the professionalism, and the commitment — we will take care of you and grow together.





What to Expect

Qualified applicants will be contacted for a short written screening, followed by a video interview over Google Meet. We move quickly with candidates who demonstrate they are the right fit.



This is a long-term role with a team that takes care of its people. If you are serious about real estate, serious about quality, and ready to work hard alongside people who will do the same — we want to hear from you.



West Coast Living | Oakwyn Realty | Vancouver, BC

ABOUT US



Shopper Approved is an established US-based SaaS company serving about 3,000 clients. We run an AWS-hosted PHP/Laravel platform and work asynchronously with a development team in Pakistan. Our staff is distributed across the United States, Mexico, and the Philippines. This is a permanent, full-time, 100% remote role.



THE ROLE



You own the infrastructure side of a live production SaaS platform. You keep it healthy and recoverable, you make deployments safer, and you replace manual server work with automation that actually holds up. A separate specialist owns employee IT and helpdesk — you will never be asked to reset someone's password or fix a printer.



This is a real production-ownership role. You will hold privileged access to systems that 3,000 paying clients depend on. We are looking for someone who has carried that weight before and treats it seriously.



READ THIS FIRST — SCHEDULE



Working hours are 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM US Mountain Time, Monday through Friday.



In Philippine time that is:



9:00 PM to 6:00 AM PHT (mid-March through early November)

10:00 PM to 7:00 AM PHT (early November through mid-March)



Yes, this is a permanent night shift. The one-hour move twice a year is US daylight saving; the Philippines does not observe it, so your local hours shift with ours. Only apply if you can hold this schedule reliably, year-round, long term.



The upside of this schedule: you overlap with US leadership for essentially your entire shift, and with our development team in Pakistan for roughly the first five hours. You will not be working in isolation.



Occasional approved maintenance windows or critical i
 may fall outside your regular hours. This is not continuous 24/7 on-call coverage, and we do not expect you to be reachable around the clock.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Day-to-day AWS and Linux production infrastructure operations

Ubuntu application servers, Nginx/Apache, PHP-FPM, queues, workers, scheduled jobs, TLS, storage, and capacity

EC2, RDS, VPC, IAM, S3, monitoring, backup, restoration, i
 triage, and cost signals

Golden/base AMI creation, patching, validation, promotion, rollback, and retirement

Datadog and CloudWatch observability, and alerts that are actually actionable

Platform readiness, post-deploy validation, and rollback support for deployments initiated by our development partner from Bitbucket

Infrastructure automation, source-controlled operational change, runbooks, and clean asynchronous handoffs

Reviewed security, IAM, network, backup, and cost improvements



WHAT YOU WILL NOT OWN



Employee laptops, SaaS access,
 quarantine, onboarding/offboarding, printers, or office helpdesk

Application feature development

Unilateral high-risk architecture changes or production-network migration

Any physical or onsite work

Sole 24/7 coverage



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Three or more years of hands-on Linux and cloud operations, or equivalent depth you can demonstrate

Production AWS work with EC2, RDS, VPC, IAM, S3, monitoring, and backups

Production web operations with Nginx or Apache, plus real process and service troubleshooting

Repeatable patching, image creation, configuration management, or infrastructure-as-code

Deployment, rollback, i
 response, and restoration you have actually tested — not just configured

Bash, Python, or another practical automation language

Strong written English and sound judgment with privileged production access

A reliable primary internet connection and a practical backup plan (mobile data, second ISP, or a nearby fallback location)



HELPFUL, NOT REQUIRED



PHP/Laravel, PHP-FPM, Supervisor, or Laravel Horizon operations

Datadog APM, logs, and metrics; Cloudflare

Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Packer, or EC2 Image Builder

Migrating legacy infrastructure into something repeatable

SOC 2 or another evidence-driven control environment



WHAT WE PROVIDE



Genuine ownership of the platform, with the authority to fix root causes instead of patching symptoms

Direct access to US leadership during your shift — no layers between you and a decision

A documented environment and a defined scope

Long-term stability; we are hiring for years, not for a project



COMPENSATION



$1200 USD per month, depending on demonstrated experience and the final employment arrangement. Local-currency payment, benefits, leave, holidays, equipment, and after-hours terms will be written into the offer. Night-shift hours are reflected in the rate.



HOW WE HIRE



A structured screen focused on production systems you personally owned

A scenario-based technical and security interview

A paid 90-minute synthetic production-i
 assessment

A live defense of your work, with the facts changed on you

References from people who directly observed your production work



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word SNAPSHOT so we know you read the whole posting. Applications without it are not reviewed.



Then answer these six questions directly. Be specific — vague answers get filtered immediately.



Describe the largest production environment you personally operated. How many servers, roughly what traffic, and what was your actual scope of responsibility?

Walk us through one production i
 you handled end to end. What broke, how did you find it, what did you do, and what did you change afterward so it could not happen again?

Have you personally performed a real restore from backup — not a configuration, an actual restore? Describe it.

What have you automated that replaced manual server work? Tools, approach, and what it saved.

Confirm you can reliably work 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM PHT (10:00 PM to 7:00 AM during US winter), Monday through Friday, year-round. Describe your internet setup and your backup plan.

What monthly rate are you looking for?



Please do not send a generic cover letter or a copy-pasted résumé blast. We read every application that follows these instructions.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable to fulfill this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP.



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person who contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea ---------- mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 12% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

title: Talent Resourcer
description:
About Us



We are a specialist property and real estate recruitment agency based in Australia. We partner with leading developers, commercial property groups, asset owners, agencies, and build-to-rent operators across Queensland and nationally.



We're looking for a highly skilled Talent Resourcer to support our consultants by identifying and mapping talent, building candidate pipelines, and leveraging AI to streamline recruitment processes.



This is a research-focused role with no candidate calling or sales activity required.



Key Responsibilities



• Conduct candidate searches using LinkedIn Recruiter, SEEK Talent Search, and other sourcing platforms • Build targeted candidate lists based on detailed recruitment briefs • Create and refine Boolean search strings for niche and hard-to-fill roles • Map competitors, target companies, and talent pools across specific industries • Identify passive candidates and collect relevant market intelligence • Utilise AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot and Claude to assist with sourcing, research, job advertisements and administrative tasks • Draft engaging job advertisements from client briefs • Maintain accurate candidate records and sourcing notes within our CRM • Assist with market mapping projects and talent pipeline development



What We're Looking For



• Previous experience in recruitment sourcing, talent research, executive search, or recruitment administration • Strong Boolean search skills • Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and/or SEEK Talent Search • Strong internet research and data gathering skills • High attention to detail and accuracy • Excellent written English • Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity • Able to work independently and meet deadlines • Reliable internet connection and home office setup



What Success Looks Like



• Consultants receive well-targeted candidate lists ready for outreach • Accurate and detailed talent maps are produced for client assignments • Boolean searches consistently identify candidates not found through simple keyword searches • Job advertisements are created quickly and professionally using AI tools • Research projects are delivered accurately and on time



Benefits



• Fully remote position • No phone-based sales or candidate calling required • Flexible working arrangements • Work directly with an experienced Australian recruitment team



To Apply



Please include:



A brief summary of your recruitment or sourcing experience

An example of a Boolean search you've created



Ideal rate: AUD $5-8/hour depending on experience and capability.

title: Creator Managers
description:
Hey! We’re currently looking for a **Creator Operations Manager** to join our team.



We run an agency working with a large number of TikTok Shop creators and video editors, and we’re looking for someone who can help manage the day-to-day relationship between our **creators/clients and editors**, while also helping moderate and support users inside our software.



Your main responsibility would be making sure everything runs smoothly from the 
nt a creator submits videos until the final edited videos are delivered.



This would include:



• Communicating with creators/clients

• Communicating with and managing editors

• Assigning/overseeing editing work

• Making sure editors are completing videos correctly and on time

• Checking that editors are following the correct reference/style

• Keeping track of outstanding videos and deadlines

• Handling revision requests between creators and editors

• Following up with editors when something is late or incorrect

• Helping resolve problems between creators and editors

• Making sure creators receive their completed videos

• Monitoring activity inside our software

• Responding to support tickets and common user questions

• Helping creators/brands understand how to use the platform

• Escalating more complicated issues to our team when necessary



We need someone who is **very organized, responsive, and good at communicating.**



You should be comfortable managing multiple creators and editors at the same time and keeping track of a lot of moving pieces without things getting lost.



We will provide you with information and training about our services and software. **You will need to learn the platform well enough to confidently answer a list of common questions from creators, editors, and users.**



This is not just a one-time project. We’re looking for someone who can work with us **consistently and long-term** as we continue bringing more TikTok Shop creators, editors, brands, and users onto the platform.



If you're interested, please send me your experience with **customer support, operations, project management, managing freelancers/teams, or working with creators.** Also let me know your availability and how many hours per day/week you can consistently work.

title: Social Media & Content Manager — Long-Term Position
description:
# Social Media & Content Manager — Long-Term Position



We are looking for a **full
-term Social Media & Content Manager** to help manage and grow a personal brand and software company across multiple social media platforms.



We need someone who is **extremely consistent, organized, creative, and proactive.**



The biggest priority is CONSISTENCY.



We want to be posting **every single day** across:



* TikTok

* Instagram

* YouTube

* Snapchat

* X /



You will help take content, ideas, raw footage, finished videos, testimonials, software updates, and other assets and turn them into consistent daily content across all platforms.



## What You'll Be Responsible For



**Daily Posting & Management**



* Make sure content is posted consistently every day

* Upload and schedule TikToks, Reels and YouTube Shorts

* Create and post Instagram Stories

* Help maintain daily Snapchat activity

* Write and publish posts/tweets on X

* Write captions, titles, hooks and CTAs

* Make sure we NEVER simply forget to post



**Content Repurposing**



* Take one piece of content and find multiple ways to use it

* Turn TikToks into Reels and YouTube Shorts

* Pull ideas/quotes from videos for X posts

* Turn results, testimonials and screenshots into Stories/posts

* Adapt content appropriately for each platform



**Content Planning**



* Build weekly and daily content calendars

* Tell me EXACTLY what content I need to film

* Organize raw footage and completed content

* Keep track of what is being edited, ready to post, scheduled and already posted

* Make sure we always have content prepared ahead of time



**Content Ideas & Research**



* Research viral/trending content

* Find TikTok/Reels/Shorts formats we can recreate

* Research competitors and successful creators

* Bring us specific content ideas, hooks and references

* Help come up with content around TikTok Shop, entrepreneurship, software, creators and building businesses



**Software Content**

We also operate Creator Toolbox, a software platform built for creators and brands.



You will help create and manage content for the software, including:



* Feature demonstrations

* Product updates

* Creator/brand educational content

* Testimonials/results

* Short-form promotional content

* Social posts

* Stories

* 
s/trending formats

* Calls to action

* Behind-the-scenes content



A lot of this content should be something you can eventually create WITHOUT needing me to personally film every post.



**Working With Editors**

We have video editors who will handle much of the editing.



You may also be responsible for:



* Sending raw footage to editors

* Giving editors references/instructions

* Reviewing completed videos

* Requesting revisions

* Organizing finished videos

* Scheduling/posting approved content



You do NOT need to personally edit every video.



## What We're Looking For



We want someone who:



* Has experience managing social media accounts

* Understands TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat and X

* Understands short-form content

* Understands hooks, retention and viral content

* Is VERY organized

* Communicates quickly

* Can work independently

* Can follow instructions

* Can learn my personal content/writing style

* Can write naturally in English

* Can research trends and competitors

* Can manage multiple accounts at once

* Is comfortable working with video editors

* Can consistently get things done WITHOUT needing to be reminded

* Wants a long-term position



You should be PROACTIVE.



I don't want to have to message every day asking:



"Did we post today?"



You should be the person reminding ME:



"We need these 3 videos filmed today."



## How to Apply



Please answer ALL of these questions:



1. What social media accounts have you managed? Please send links/examples.



2. Which platforms do you have experience managing: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat and X/Twitter?



3. Which platform are you strongest at?



4. Have you managed a personal brand before?



5. Have you managed a business/software social media account before?



6. Can you create basic social media graphics/content yourself?



7. Can you edit short-form videos? If yes, what software do you use?



8. Have you worked with separate video editors before?



9. How would you turn ONE TikTok video into content for all five of our platforms?



10. How would you make sure every account gets posted on every day without me reminding you?



11. How do you research viral content and trends?



12. How would you organize raw footage ? editing ? revisions ? approved ? scheduled ? posted?



13. If I didn't send you enough new footage one week, what would you do to keep the accounts active?



14. What hours are you available?



15. Are you looking for a long-term position?



**IMPORTANT:** Start your application with the words **"CONTENT EVERY DAY"** so I know you actually read the entire job post.



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our team long-term. As our brands and platforms grow, there will be opportunities for the role to grow as well.

title: Real Estate Cold Caller/Appointment Setter

Working Hours:

Monday - Friday 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM EST

Opportunity to move into full-time role

 • Make outbound calls daily using our provided dialer and call list

title: Cinematic Video Editor for Documentary Series — Netflix-Style Storytelling
description:
We are looking for a highly creative video editor for an ongoing documentary/experiential series filmed in the United States.



This is not a basic video editing position.



We need an editor who can take raw footage and turn it into a compelling story that feels cinematic, dynamic, emotional, and premium — closer to the pacing and storytelling of a Netflix documentary or reality-doc series than a traditional YouTube video.



The editor must be able to make creative decisions independently. We do not want to explain where every cut, B-roll shot, sound effect, music change, or emotional 
nt should go.



Your job is to find the story inside the footage.



What you’ll be editing:



Episodes may include:



aviation and learning to fly;

farms and physical work;

motorsports and extreme experiences;

unusual American professions and subcultures;

interviews combined with real-life action and experiences.



Typical final episodes: approximately 30–60 minutes.



What we expect:



Strong storytelling and sense of narrative.

Dynamic pacing that maintains viewer attention.

Ability to identify the strongest emotional 
nts in raw footage.

Creative use of B-roll and cutaways.

Professional sound design.

Music that supports tension, emotion, humor, fear, or excitement.

Strong opening sequences that make viewers want to continue watching.

Cinematic transitions when appropriate — without excessive effects.

title: Growth-Minded Mid/Senior Python Developer
description:
Do you enjoy development and stimulating work that we approach like a game, with challenges and learning, all while doing great work with teammates who care? Let’s team up.



We believe in people. This is why we only work with clients who serve people. From firefighters, to law firms, to suppliers sending life-saving food to kids dying of malnutrition, the code you write will help make the world a better place.



Our team is made up of people who want to do the best work of their life. People who love to learn, challenge themselves, grow and have some fun along the journey. Now, ready to learn more about this opening? Buckle up.

- Are attentive to details.

- Have 3+ years of Python development experience.



You probably shouldn’t apply if:

- You’re “just looking for extra money.”

- You like working 5 full-time jobs because all you care about is work.

- You get offended easily and take things personally.

- You are not someone with grit and determination who can persevere while being challenged to do great work.

- You get overwhelmed easily with new code, new habits, new learnings and chat messages.



The interview process:

. (With lots of questions, sprinkled with a few voice notes)

- You may be able to speak with a developer or two on our team to see how they like the role.



If you work here:

- You’ll get 13th month salary, Filipino holidays, unlimited time off (we don’t count sick days), a normal working day schedule (no night shifts, although an early start is preferred for time overlap) with some flexibility, a week off during the holidays in December, and the opportunity to grow and become your best self.



A little more about us:

- We’ve been in business for a decade+. Our teams are remote (mostly in the Philippines). Our longest standing tea
mber has been with us for over 13+ years. We've had people quit smoking on our teams with our help, lose weight, learn a new instrument, speak a new language, and more. We all love what we do.



How to begin

- Your mission, should you choose to accept, is to send us an
 with 3 questions you have about this role here at 
 code 571739. If you’re currently in a full-time role and are looking for something new, we’re open to a transition window. We actually care about your happiness.

title: WIX FUNNEL, CRM & AUTOMATION SPECIALIST
description:
WIX FUNNEL, CRM & AUTOMATION SPECIALIST

AI Quiz/Diagnostic Experience Preferred



I am looking for a skilled Wix funnel, CRM and automation specialist to build the lead-generation,
 marketing, client-conversion and onboarding infrastructure for an established consulting business.



This is NOT a general VA position, and I am NOT looking for someone to redesign an entire website.



The website, branding and core offers already exist.



I need someone who can build the SYSTEM behind the website so there is a clear journey from:



Visitor ? Lead ? CRM ? Segmented Audience ?
 Nurture ? Offer ? Client ? Onboarding ? Follow-Up



I also have two connected but distinct customer ecosystems that need to work within one organized backend system.



THE TWO CUSTOMER ECOSYSTEMS



ECOSYSTEM 1: CONSULTING BUSINESS



The primary business focuses on visibility, business development, strategic relationships, partnerships, sponsorships and identifying overlooked business opportunities.



One of the core services is a proprietary business visibility assessment.



I want to develop a shorter interactive diagnostic/quiz that can serve as a lead-generation tool and eventually guide qualified prospects toward the paid assessment and other consulting services.



ECOSYSTEM 2: COMMUNITY + EVENTS



The second ecosystem is a community/event platform focused on relationships, collaboration, opportunities and in-person/virtual experiences.



People may join an
 list, attend events, express interest in future events or membership, explore opportunities, or become potential sponsors/partners.



These two ecosystems are related, but they should NOT simply receive the same
s.



A contact may be interested in:



• Consulting

• Community/events

• Both



I want one organized CRM whenever possible with appropriate segmentation, automation and communication for each audience.



WHAT I NEED BUILT



PHASE 1: FUNNEL + CRM ARCHITECTURE



Review my existing Wix setup and help map the customer journeys.



I want Wix to become the central system for capturing and organizing leads whenever possible.



The CRM should allow me to understand:



• Where a contact came from

• Which ecosystem they are interested in

• What action they have taken

• Whether they have opted into
 communication

• What type of communication they should receive

• Whether they are a lead, prospect, client, past client, event attendee, community member, partner, sponsor, etc.

• Where they currently are in their journey

• What should happen next



This may include:



• CRM stages

• Tags/labels

• Custom fields

• Source tracking

• Automations

•
 preferences

• Segmentation

• Forms

• Internal notifications



I want the CRM architecture designed correctly from the beginning so I do not end up with disconnected lists, duplicate contacts or systems that do not communicate with each other.



PHASE 2: INTERACTIVE DIAGNOSTIC / QUIZ



I want to create a short interactive diagnostic on my website that generates leads while providing something genuinely valuable to the user.



The experience should allow someone to:



• Answer a series of questions

• Submit their contact information

• Receive a score, result or diagnosis

• Receive personalized feedback based on their answers

• Receive a recommended next step

• Automatically enter the appropriate CRM segment and nurture sequence



I am interested in using AI to create a more personalized output based on the person's responses.



I am open to the right technical solution. This could involve Wix functionality, Velo, APIs or an outside quiz/AI tool integrated with Wix.



I need someone who can recommend AND implement the simplest reliable solution.



The shorter diagnostic would ultimately guide qualified prospects toward a more comprehensive paid assessment or other consulting services.



PHASE 3: COMMUNITY/EVENT FUNNEL



My second ecosystem needs its own journey while still connecting to the central CRM.



Someone may:



• Join/request information

• Register for an event

• Attend an event

• Receive event follow-up

• Learn about future events

• Express interest in future membership/community opportunities

• Express interest in sponsorship/partnership opportunities

• Join the appropriate
 audience



These contacts need to be properly captured, tagged and segmented.



I also want the two ecosystems to be able to cross-promote appropriately without automatically putting everyone on every
 list.



PHASE 4:
 MARKETING + NURTURE



I need an organized
 marketing system rather than contacts scattered in different places.



This includes:



• Lead capture

• Proper
 opt-in

• Segmented Wix contact lists

• Automated follow-up sequences

• Diagnostic/quiz follow-up

• Community/event follow-up

• Automated nurture sequences

• Reusable branded
 templates

• A simple process for sending weekly or biweekly
s

• Appropriate communication for each audience

• CTAs that direct people toward the appropriate next step, event, diagnostic or offer



The goal is for me to be able to open my CRM and understand WHO I can communicate with, WHY they are in my database, WHAT they are interested in and WHAT communication is relevant to them.



PHASE 5: PAID CLIENT FUNNEL + ONBOARDING



When someone purchases or books a consulting service, I want a clearly defined next step every time.



Depending on the offer, this may include:



• Service/pricing page

• Purchase or booking

• Confirmation

• Website-based client intake

• CRM status update

• Automated onboarding

• Scheduling

• Internal notifications

• Client delivery workflow

• Follow-up

• Pathway to the next appropriate service



I want the system to operate without requiring me to manually remember every next step.



PHASE 6: SOPs + HANDOFF



Everything built must be documented.



I already have a VA who is strong at research, organization and documentation and will help maintain our internal SOP library.



The specialist hired for this project needs to document the technical systems they build so my VA and I can understand, maintain and operate them.



Documentation should include:



• How each funnel works

• How contacts enter the CRM

• CRM structure

• Tags/stages/segments

• Audience segmentation

• Automations

•
 sequences

• How to send regular
s

• How to make basic edits

• How the diagnostic/AI integration works

• How to troubleshoot common issues

• What happens at each stage of each journey



Loom walkthroughs and clear step-by-step documentation are strongly preferred.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



Experience with several of the following:



• Wix

• Wix CRM

• Wix Forms

• Wix Automations

• Wix
 Marketing

• Wix Bookings

• Wix Payments

• Funnel building

• CRM architecture

• Audience segmentation

•
 nurture sequences

• Interactive quizzes/assessments

• AI integrations

• Velo and/or API integrations

• Service-based businesses

• Community/event funnels

• SOP/documentation creation



MOST IMPORTANTLY: I NEED SOMEONE WHO THINKS IN SYSTEMS.



I am not looking for someone who simply knows how to create attractive Wix pages.



I want someone who naturally thinks:



What happens when this person clicks this button?



Where does their information go?



Why are they entering the database?



What are they interested in?



How should they be categorized?



What happens automatically?



Which
 should they receive?



What should the business owner or VA do next?



I prefer SIMPLE systems. Please do not recommend additional software unless there is a clear reason Wix cannot accomplish what is needed.



This will begin as a paid project with the possibility of ongoing work.



HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



1. Start your application with the exact words:



VISIBILITY MATTERS



If those words are not at the beginning of your application, I will not review it.



2. Send 2–3 examples of funnels, CRM systems, automations, quizzes or customer journeys you have personally built.



Tell me specifically what YOU built.



3. In no more than 5 bullet points, explain how you would approach this journey:



Website visitor ? short diagnostic ? personalized result ? CRM/email sequence ? paying client.



I am NOT asking for a detailed free strategy. I simply want to see whether you understand how the pieces connect.



4. Imagine I have two related but different audiences: consulting clients and community/event participants.



In 2–3 sentences, explain how you would structure ONE CRM so someone could be interested in one audience or both without everyone receiving the same
s.



5. Tell me about your Wix experience specifically. Please do not simply tell me that you have built websites.



6. For an interactive diagnostic that potentially uses AI to personalize results, would you first explore building it within Wix or recommend another tool/API? Briefly explain WHY.



7. Tell me what information you would need FRO
 before you could begin building.



8. Have you created SOPs or Loom training documentation for systems you have built? Please share an example if available.



9. Include your hourly or project rate, availability and timezone.



Please do not apply if your primary experience is Canva, social media management, data entry, basic website editing or general virtual assistance.



I am specifically looking for someone who can architect, build, test, document and hand off a complete working system.



Additional business details, website access and proprietary information will be provided only to selected candidates as appropriate.

title: Logistics Operations Manager
description:
About the Role



This role sits inside a global logistics technology company that helps e-commerce brands streamline international fulfillment. As Logistics Operations Manager, you own the daily playbooks that keep freight moving on schedule and inventory accurate, coordinating with freight brokers, reconciling inventory on receipt, ensuring timely warehouse inbounding, and applying sound judgment on the roughly 10% of daily operations that fall outside standard procedure. You are embedded directly with a growth-stage business and leadership team who need a technically strong, independent operator, with ongoing coaching, clear standards, and a dedicated Success Manager behind you so you can focus on doing excellent work.

This is a dedicated, full-time role designed for meaningful impact, stability, and professional growth in logistics and cross-border operations.



Responsibilities

• Execute daily logistics operations playbooks, applying independent judgment on the estimated 10% of cases that fall outside standard procedure

• Source and compare freight brokerage quotes, balancing delivery timelines against cost to secure the best option for each shipment

• Coordinate directly with freight brokers to confirm bookings, track shipments in transit, and resolve delays

• Reconcile inventory upon receipt, verifying quantities and condition against purchase orders and manifests

• Ensure timely warehouse inbounding, coordinating with warehouse teams to prevent processing bottlenecks

• Review commercial invoices for accuracy on cross-border shipments before they move forward

/calendar tools (e.g., Outlook, Asana, etc.)

title: Texas Residential Real Estate Virtual Assistant / Transaction Coordinator
description:
exas Residential Real Estate Virtual Assistant / Transaction Coordinator



Please read carefully before applying. Applications without complete answers may not be reviewed.

We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented virtual assistant based in the Philippines with direct U.S. residential real estate experience.



This is a fast-paced role supporting a busy residential real estate agent in Fort Worth, Texas. The right candidate must be able to work quickly, track open tasks without being reminded, ask good questions early, and produce client-ready work with minimal errors.



Texas residential real estate experience is strongly preferred. Experience with Keller Williams, Sotheby’s, Compass, Coldwell Banker, RE/MAX, eXp, or a similar brokerage is preferred.

R1 - Based in the Philippines.

s with minimal typos.

 for clarity and errors.

title: Video Editor: Fitness Content & Meta Ads
description:
About the Role:

I run a personal fitness influencer page and a fitness-related business that's growing fast, fast enough that I can no longer keep up with editing myself. I'm looking for someone to take that off my plate long-term.



This starts part-time (2 hours/day) but I'm hiring for growth: as the business scales, so will your hours, up to full-time. I want someone who's genuinely invested in seeing the brand grow, not just clocking hours. If you grow with me, I'll make sure it's worth your while.



You'll work across two types of content:

Short-form content for my personal fitness page (Reels/TikTok/Shorts style, voiceover clips, talking-head content)

Meta ads creative: video ads and static image ads for a rapidly growing business



What I'm Looking For (the important stuff):

Editing judgment, not just editing skill. My source clips are often ~2 minutes of voiceover footage, and only ~10 seconds might actually be used. I need someone who can watch the whole clip and pick the 
nt that will genuinely hook and hold a viewer, not just grab a random 10-second chunk.

A clean, natural editing style. I don't like heavily-edited content, no overload of transitions, effects, or gimmicky cuts. Think simple, tasteful, and fast-paced where it counts, not "busy."

Minimal AI use. I want your eye and judgment on the edit, not an AI tool doing the creative thinking for you.

Music instinct. You should be able to source trending, currently-relevant background music that actually fits the vibe/energy of each video without me having to point you to it, this is something I personally struggle with, so it's a real value-add.

Reliability during set hours. I need someone responsive and online for a consistent, agreed 2-hour window every day, not sporadic availability.

Good English (written and spoken) for daily communication and feedback.

Genuine interest in growing with the brand. This isn't a one-off gig, I'm looking for a long-term working relationship.



Responsibilities:

Edit raw voiceover/talking-head footage into short-form content, selecting the strongest, most engaging segments

Edit video ad creative for Meta campaigns (hooks, pacing, CTAs)

Design static image ads for Meta (Canva, Photoshop, or similar)

Source and add background music/sound that fits each video's tone

Add clean captions where needed

Organize footage and finished assets

Communicate daily during your working hours and take feedback well



Requirements:

Experience editing short-form video (personal brand and/or ad creative)

Proficient in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or Final Cut Pro

Comfortable with Canva and/or Photoshop for static ads

A portfolio/reel: please include examples that show restrained, natural editing (not heavily effect-driven), and ideally something with voiceover/talking-head footage

Reliable internet and equipment

Available for a consistent 2-hour daily window (state your available hours, ideally with overlap with AEST)



Nice to Have:

Fitness/health niche experience

Basic Meta Ads Manager familiarity

Experience picking trending audio for organic content specifically (not just ads)



Work Details:

Location: Remote

Type: Part-time to start (2 hrs/day), and willing and able to increase hours as the business grows

Start: Immediately



How to Apply: Please send-

Your portfolio/demo reel: prioritize examples with clean, simple editing and voiceover-style content if you have it

Your available 2-hour daily window and timezone

title: Senior Finance & Operations Manager (CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Position: Senior Finance & Operations Manager (CPA Preferred)



Location: Remote (Philippines)



Overview

We are a growing Canadian construction and service company looking for someone who wants more than a traditional accounting role.



We're looking for a reliable, proactive, and highly organized professional who can take ownership of our finance and administrative operations. This person will play a key role in helping leadership make informed decisions, maintain healthy cash flow, and ensure the business runs smoothly behind the scenes.



The ideal candidate is a self-motivated leader who anticipates business needs before they arise. We value a professional who communicates with clarity, maintains flawless organization, and demonstrates a relentless commitment to following through on every initiative.



Key Responsibilities

- Full cycle bookkeeping using QuickBooks Online

- Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable

- Weekly cash flow forecasting and reporting

- Bank reconciliations and payment scheduling

- Monitor company cash position and flag potential cash flow issues early

- Follow up on outstanding customer payments

- Payroll support and payroll reconciliations

- Budget tracking and financial analysis

- Assist with month end and year end preparation

- Work closely with our Canadian CPA

- Maintain financial records and support compliance requirements

- Assist with HR administration and employee records

- Improve internal processes, documentation, and financial controls

- Keep leadership informed of important deadlines, risks, and priorities

- Help create reports that support business growth and decision making



Who are we looking for

- CPA preferred

- Has experience supporting Canadian companies

- Strong QuickBooks Online experience

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Strong understanding of cash flow management

- Superior proficiency in written and verbal English

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail

- Honest, dependable, and accountable

- Able to manage confidential financial information with integrity

- Comfortable working independently while keeping leadership informed

- Positive attitude and willingness to continuously improve systems



What Success Looks Like



Within the first six months, you will:



- Keep financial records accurate and up to date.

- Ensure payments and payroll are processed on time.

- Maintain reliable cash flow forecasts that support decision making.

- Proactively identify financial risks before they become problems.

- Improve at least two internal processes that increase efficiency or accuracy.

- Become a trusted member of the leadership team through consistency, communication, and accountability.



If you're looking for a long term opportunity where your work truly makes an impact, we'd love to hear from you.



Please send your resume, expected monthly salary, and a short introduction explaining why you're the right fit for this role.

title: Experienced GoHighLevel Specialist – CRM, AI, Automations & Funnels
description:
Starting Pay: $7.00 USD/hour — NON-NEGOTIABLE

IMPORTANT: THIS IS NOT A BEGINNER OR ENTRY-LEVEL GHL POSITION.



We are looking for an experienced GoHighLevel specialist to become a key technical resource for multiple home improvement and lead-generation businesses.



Please do not apply if you are currently learning GoHighLevel, have only basic experience building funnels, or require step-by-step instructions for normal GHL functions.



We need someone who already understands GHL well enough to build, troubleshoot, research, test and solve problems independently.



The starting rate for this position is $7.00 USD per hour. This starting rate is firm and is not negotiable. Please do not apply asking for a higher starting rate.



What We Need



This is much more than a funnel-building position.



We need someone capable of handling the technical side of our GoHighLevel infrastructure and eventually taking significant ownership over our CRM, automations, AI systems and funnels.



You should have strong working knowledge of:



GHL CRM setup and management

Advanced workflows and automations

Pipelines and opportunities

Custom fields, tags and contact management

Calendars and appointment scheduling

Lead routing and qualification

GHL Voice AI

SMS and
 automations

Funnels and landing pages

 and Google lead 

Tracking and attribution

Webhooks and third-party integrations

User access and GHL configuration

Troubleshooting existing GHL systems

Testing systems before they are deployed



Experience with Zapier, Make, APIs, webhooks, JavaScript or custom integrations is a major advantage.



The Level of Independence We Expect



We will sometimes provide extremely detailed instructions. Other times, you will be given an objective and expected to determine the technical solution.



For example, we may say:



“Build an after-hours AI receptionist that qualifies incoming callers, determines their service area and schedules them into the appropriate calendar.”



An experienced candidate should be capable of determining how to build the system, researching anything necessary, configuring it, testing different scenarios, identifying problems and presenting a working solution.



We are not looking for someone who stops working every time they encounter something they haven't done before.



We understand that nobody knows every feature of GoHighLevel. Research is completely acceptable and encouraged. What matters is your ability to find answers, troubleshoot problems and continue making progress independently.



If something genuinely requires administrator access or additional permissions, we expect you to identify specifically what is required and communicate it clearly.



AI & Automation



AI will be an increasingly important part of this position.



We are building systems involving:



Voice AI • Conversation AI • Automated Scheduling • Lead Qualification • CRM Automation • Automated Follow-Up • Knowledge Bases • Call Handling • Lead Routing



You should either already have strong experience with GHL's AI tools or be highly capable of working with them.



Our goal isn't simply to have AI features turned on. We want AI systems that actually work reliably with real customers.



That means testing different customer scenarios, finding weaknesses in the conversation flow and continuously improving the system.



Funnels & Lead Generation



You should also be capable of building professional, conversion-focused GHL funnels and landing pages.



Our businesses generate leads through Google,
 and other marketing channels, so these pages need to do more than look attractive.



You should understand mobile-first design, calls to action, lead capture, conversion flow, social proof, trust building, chat integration, tracking and responsive design.



We operate primarily in the home improvement and lead-generation industries, so experience with contractors or home-service businesses is a plus.



Who We Want



We are looking for someone who is:



Experienced. Technical. Resourceful. Reliable. Organized. Detail-oriented.



Most importantly, we want someone who can take ownership of a project.



When you encounter a problem, your first instinct should be to investigate it and determine the solution—not simply wait for someone else to tell you what to do.



At the same time, good communication is extremely important. If something requires information, access or a business decision from us, communicate exactly what you need.



Compensation



Starting pay: $7.00 USD per hour.



The starting rate is NON-NEGOTIABLE.



Please only apply if you are comfortable beginning at $7/hour.



We are looking for someone interested in establishing a long-term working relationship and taking on greater responsibility as our systems continue to grow.



How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following:



How many years/months have you actively worked inside GoHighLevel?

What would you rate your GHL knowledge from 1–10, and why?

Describe the most technically advanced GHL system you have personally built.

Describe your experience with GHL Voice AI.

Describe your experience with Conversation AI and AI knowledge bases.

What types of GHL workflows and automations have you built?

Have you worked with APIs, webhooks, Zapier, Make or custom code? Explain.

Send examples of GHL funnels you personally built.

Send a Loom video showing us inside a GHL account or system you personally built and explain how it works.

What hours are you available to work in Eastern Time (US)?

Confirm in your application: “I understand the starting rate is $7.00 USD/hour and I am comfortable with this rate.”



Applications that do not answer the questions above may not be considered.



Please Do Not Apply If:



You are brand new to GoHighLevel, are currently taking a course to learn GHL, have primarily worked as a general VA, only know basic funnel/page building, or need extensive training before you can independently manage GHL projects.



We are hiring someone because we need GHL expertise on our team—not someone we need to teach GoHighLevel from the beginning.

Experience with LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and

title: Client Care & Inside Sales Coordinator — $6/Hour + Benefits and Performance Incentives
description:
Long-Term Growth Opportunity to Become Office Manager

Note: Cover Letter and Voice Recording Required to Apply.

Do you love providing excellent service in a support-based role?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing a variety of tasks? Do you love talking to customers and providing excellent customer service? Keep reading!

About Boulder Pro Painters

Boulder Pro Painters is a growing residential and commercial painting company serving Boulder, Colorado. We are committed to becoming one of the most trusted and highly reviewed painting companies in our area by providing excellent craftsmanship and an amazing customer experience.

We are a very entrepreneurial company, and we believe strongly in taking care of our customers and our amazing tea
mbers by providing a great work environment and career growth opportunities.

We value integrity, responsibility, and life balance. We believe work should empower your life, not take away from it. You should love where you work, be treated well, be part of a great team, and have opportunities to grow in your career.

Our growth and success depend on the culture we are creating. Our team is made up of ambitious and dependable people, with a heavy focus on personal growth and professional development to ensure our tea
mbers achieve their goals and all they are capable of while producing great results for the company, our customers, and our team.

In this role, you will work directly with me, the Founder and CEO of Boulder Pro Painters. You will help me manage customer communication, lead qualification, scheduling, follow-up, and the day-to-day organization of the business.

This is an important, long-term role with the opportunity to learn the business, take ownership of your responsibilities, increase your hours, and grow into our Office Manager as the company continues to grow.

Your Role and What You’ll Be Doing

We’re committed to creating an extraordinary company that provides excellent customer service for our customers. We want our customers talking about what an amazing experience they had working with Boulder Pro Painters. We want customers for life.

This role is a large part of that. Here are a few things you’ll be doing regularly:

* Answering the company phone line. In this business, it’s important that when customers call, someone answers or responds promptly.

* Making initial calls to customers who have requested an estimate.

* Asking qualification questions to understand the customer’s goals, project, location, timeline, and expectations.

* Following up with customers who have requested an estimate and setting appointments for me to meet with them.

* Managing estimate appointments in my calendar.

* Confirming appointments and handling cancellations and rescheduling requests.

* Following up with leads who have not responded or scheduled an appointment.

* Following up with customers who received an estimate but have not made a decision.

* Updating our CRM and lead tracker with accurate customer information, notes, appointments, and follow-up activities.

* Keeping my calendar and daily priorities organized.

* Sending appointment confirmations, reminders, and routine customer communications.

* Supporting me with administrative responsibilities and the day-to-day organization of the business.

As you learn our processes and demonstrate your ability, you will take on additional responsibilities, including:

* Reconnecting with old leads and past customers.

* Requesting customer reviews and referrals.

* Reaching out to property managers, real estate agents, designers, and other referral partners.

* Supporting customers after their project is approved.

* Sending routine project updates and helping customers understand the next steps.

* Tracking outstanding customer decisions, colors, scheduling details, and project information.

* Helping improve our scripts, processes, and systems.

* Preparing simple lead, estimate, and follow-up reports.

* Taking ownership of additional office-management responsibilities.

Who We Are Looking For — About You

* You thrive in a fast-paced work environment.

* You love being in a support role, and you love making other people’s lives easier.

* You enjoy talking with customers, and you get satisfaction from providing customers with an amazing experience each and every time you interact with them.

* You are a natural communicator, and you’re very comfortable talking on the phone.

* You speak and write excellent English and can communicate naturally and confidently with customers in the United States.

* People say you have great energy—you’re a positive, optimistic person.

* You’re a go-getter. You don’t need to be told what to do at every step.

* You are proactive and always looking for what else you can provide to the business and the team.

* You are highly organized and pay close attention to details.

* You follow through on your commitments without needing repeated reminders.

* You take ownership when something needs to be completed.

* You can follow an established process while still having a natural conversation.

* You are comfortable asking qualification questions and discussing project expectations.

* You can manage multiple conversations, appointments, and follow-ups without losing track of important details.

* You are comfortable receiving feedback, practicing calls, and continuously improving.

* You want a stable, long-term position where you can grow with the company.

* You are available to transition into a full-time overnight schedule as your training and responsibilities increase.

* You have reliable high-speed internet, a dependable computer, a professional headset, and a quiet workspace.

* You have a dependable backup plan for power or internet interruptions.

Previous experience in inside sales, customer service, appointment setting, office administration, or supporting a US-based company is preferred.

Experience with a home-service company, Google Workspace, GoHighLevel, CRM systems, or scheduling software is helpful but not required. We are willing to train the right person who has the right attitude, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

Compensation & Job Details

* This is a remote, long-term position for candidates located in the Philippines.

* The position will begin with a paid 30-day introductory and training period of approximately 20 hours per week.

* Initial working hours will generally be Monday through Friday, from 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. Mountain Time.

* The position is intended to increase to 30–40 hours per week within approximately 30–60 days as training is completed, performance is demonstrated, and additional responsibilities are transferred.

* Candidates must have the availability and desire to transition to full-time.

* Full-time working hours will be Monday through Friday, from 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Mountain Time, with a one-hour unpaid meal break.

* Colorado observes daylight-saving time, so the corresponding Philippine schedule will shift by one hour during the year.

* Your starting compensation is $6 USD per hour.

* You will receive an additional $5 USD for every qualified estimate that is scheduled and completed.

* A qualified estimate must meet our established service area, project type, customer, timeline, and investment guidelines.

* You’ll be paid twice per month.

* Paid training is included.

* Your performance and compensation will be formally reviewed after your first 90 days.

* Strong performers may receive an increase to $7 USD per hour after the 90-day review.

* You will receive prorated 13th-month compensation based on your regular base pay and time worked during the calendar year.

* Paid time off will be available after successfully completing the 90-day introductory period.

* Additional performance incentives, raises, and promotions are available to top performers.

* This position has the opportunity to grow into our Office Manager as Boulder Pro Painters continues to grow.

This is more than a short-term virtual-assistant position. We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted member of our team, understand how the company operates, and take on greater responsibility over time.

Our business is growing, and we’re looking to hire someone within the next two to four weeks as soon as we find the right fit.

Does this job sound like a good fit for you? Do you sound like the kind of person we are looking for?

We’d love to hear from you.

To Apply, Please Include the Following Information

* Tell us why you are interested in this position and why you think you are the person we are looking for.

* Attach your résumé.

* Include a one-to-two-minute voice recording introducing yourself and describing your customer-service, inside-sales, or administrative experience.

* Confirm that you can work the initial part-time schedule and transition into the required full-time Mountain Time schedule.

* Provide your availability in both Philippine Time and Mountain Time.

* Describe your internet connection and your backup plan for power or internet interruptions.

* Tell us whether you are currently working for any other clients or employers.

* Briefly explain how you would handle a homeowner who requested an estimate but did not answer your first call.

Applications that do not include a cover letter, résumé, and voice recording will not be considered.



Best,

Jonathan Ramirez

Founder & CEO

Boulder Pro Painters

The owner runs 30+ employees across multiple companies. This seat reports into our LA management team and sits with the owner every single week.

[Data Analytics Specialist / Merchandising Specialist / Website and UX Coordinator]



Who we are actually looking for



You have held a real position at a real company. You have owned a function, not a queue of tasks. You have sat in rooms where decisions were made and you were expected to arrive with a point of view.



You are exceptionally analytical. You do not look at a dashboard and describe it. You look at it and find the thing nobody else noticed, then you build the case for what to do about it. You know the difference between a number that moved and a number that matters. You can take a messy export, find the story inside it, and explain that story to a non-technical person in one paragraph.



You know Shopify end to end. Not the basics. Everything. Collections and automated collection rules, tags, metafields, variants and inventory logic, Search and Discovery, filtering, analytics and custom reports, discounts and price rules, theme sections and templates, apps and where they break, checkout behaviour, and how all of it connects. If your Shopify experience is "I've uploaded products," this is not your role.



You manage yourself, completely. Nobody will build your day for you. You will not be handed a list of ideas to execute. You are expected to generate the ideas, prioritise them yourself, and defend why you chose one over another. If you finish everything by 2pm, you go find the next problem. That single trait matters more to us than anything on your CV.



You will lead. You are one of three specialists who run this department together, and you are expected to lead within it, hold the other two to the standard, and grow into managing people directly as we scale. We promote from this seat. We do not hire above it.



You are relentless about time. You push the limit of what can be done in a working day, every day. You are not busy, you are productive, and you know the difference. Slow weeks are visible here and they are not tolerated for long.



You have real interpersonal skill. You work daily with our LA marketing manager, inventory manager, designer,
 and social leads, and the owner. You can disagree with someone senior, make your case cleanly, and then commit to whatever gets d
. You bring problems early, not late. You are the person others want on the call.



You write and speak English at a native US standard. Not "good English." American level. Ideally you have lived, studied or worked in the United States, or spent years working directly with American executives, and it shows in how you write. We will know within two sentences.



Results, plainly



You will own a specific set of numbers. Conversion, average order value, sell through, revenue per visitor, depending on the seat. Every Friday you report what you changed and what it moved. Every month we look at whether the business actually improved.



This is a high accountability seat with real upside. People who move the numbers grow quickly here and are paid accordingly. People who cannot, do not stay. We are direct about this on day one so nobody is surprised at day 90.



Do not apply if



Your background is customer service, chat support, appointment setting, cold calling, lead generation, or general VA work

You need a script, a checklist, or daily instructions to be productive

You have never owned a number a business cared about

You want part time, or plan to run this alongside other clients

You are applying to more than three jobs today



The details



Full time, 40 hours per week, single client, long term

9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Los Angeles time. Roughly midnight to 8:00 AM Manila. Do not apply unless that is genuinely sustainable for you

Reachable and ready to join a call at short notice throughout those hours, camera on

Two short team stand ups daily, plus two meetings a week with LA management and ownership

Reports to our Marketing Manager and Inventory Manager. Weekly with the owner

Up to $2,500 per month, based on what you actually bring. Reviewed at 90 days

Clear path into a leadership seat as the department grows



How to apply



Applications that skip any step are deleted unread.



Begin your message with the word CALIBER

In three sentences: the most important decision you made in a previous role, and what happened as a result

The number you were responsible for in your last job, and whether you moved it

Answer honestly: if you finished all your assigned work by 2pm, what would you do with the rest of the day?

Rate your Shopify knowledge one to ten and justify the number with something specific you have built or fixed

Your internet setup, and your backup when the power or connection drops

A 90 second Loom or unlisted YouTube video introducing yourself. No script. We are listening to how you think and how you speak



No generic cover letters. No unrelated portfolios. Answer the seven items and nothing else.



Shortlisted candidates complete a paid test task on our real data, then interview on video with our LA team and the owner.

title: Operations Manager — Ecommerce & Property (Hands-On Role)
description:
About us



We run four businesses under one roof: a premium home décor e-commerce brand (25+ years in business, our own Florida warehouse, featured in Architectural Digest and Elle Decor), a wholesale trade division, and three self-storage and warehouse properties in Florida.



We're a small team. The owners are currently the escalation point for everything, and we're hiring you so that stops being true.



Read this part carefully



This is a working role, not a pure management role.



About half your week is overseeing a small team. The other half is doing real work yourself — the kind that takes judgment and can't be handed to a rep: chargebacks, freight paperwork, carrier claims, marketplace issues, escalations.



If you're looking for a role where you only manage and delegate, this isn't it. We want someone who's good at both and doesn't consider hands-on work beneath them.



What you'll do

The team (about half your time)

Oversee a small remote team of customer service and operations reps across e-commerce and our storage properties

Define what good performance looks like — you'll help build our KPIs, not just report on them

Track performance weekly: productivity, active hours, response times, ticket volume, resolution rates, occupancy and delinquency on the properties

Address problems the same week you see them, not the next month

Run daily check-ins and weekly one-on-ones

Own scheduling and coverage, including who covers when someone is out

Onboard and train new hires against our written procedures

Cross-train the team so no task has only one person who can do it

Run quality reviews on customer
s, chats, and calls, and coach on what you find

Document performance problems in writing, on time, following our process

Interview candidates when we're hiring

Recommend when someone isn't working out — the final call is ours, but we'll rely on your read

Building how we work

Design workflows for work that currently has none

Keep our written procedures current. When something changes, the document changes

Find recurring problems and fix the cause, not the symptom

Look for what's falling through the cracks and close the gap before we notice it

Hands-on work (about half your time)

Chargebacks and payment disputes — filing, evidence, follow-through

BOLs and freight paperwork, inbound and outbound

Carrier claims and delivery failures — the ones a rep can't resolve

Vendor and contractor invoice review — verifying what we're billed matches what was delivered

Amazon and marketplace issues that need real problem solving

Customer escalations the team can't close

Whatever else needs a brain rather than a script

Reporting

Weekly report to ownership: what moved, what didn't, what needs a decision from us

Bring us decisions, not status updates

What we're looking for



Required



2+ years managing or supervising people, with real responsibility for their performance

You've had the hard conversation. You've told someone their work wasn't good enough and documented it

Comfortable with numbers — you can read a report, spot what's wrong, and act

E-commerce operations experience (Shopify or similar)

Strong written and spoken English. You'll be on calls with US vendors, carriers, and sometimes customers

You finish things. If you start something you close it, or you tell us why it didn't close

Willing to work with time-tracking software — and to manage a team that uses it

Works US Eastern hours, Monday–Friday

No other job or client commitments



Strongly preferred



Chargeback or payment dispute experience

Freight, BOLs, carrier claims, or 3PL exposure

Amazon Seller Central

Property management, self-storage, or leasing experience

Experience writing procedures or building workflows from scratch

Experience interviewing or onboarding remote staff



Not a fit if



You want a role where you only delegate and report

You consider hands-on work below your level

You need someone above you to make routine calls

You've only managed by being liked

What we offer

Competitive rate based on experience

Real ownership. You'll shape how this operation runs, not just execute someone else's plan

A small, established, profitable company with 25+ years of history

Direct access to the owners. No layers, no politics

Written procedures for most of what we do — and where they don't exist, you'll write them

Long-term, stable position



Hours: 40 hours/week, Monday–Friday, US Eastern time.



Please note: we use time-tracking software across the entire remote team, including this role. We measure results, but activity is tracked and we're upfront about it.



To apply



Answer these in your application. Applications without answers won't be read. Write your own answers — please don't use AI.



1. Tell me about a team you managed or supervised. How many people, doing what, and what numbers were you responsible for?

2. Describe a time someone on your team wasn't performing. What exactly did you do, and how did it end?

3. You take over a team where one task has been slipping for months. Everyone tells you it's handled. It isn't. Walk me through your first two weeks.

4. Tell me about a hands-on problem you solved yourself — a dispute, a claim, a shipping mess, something complicated.  What did you do?

5. What time zone are you in, and what would 9am–5pm US Eastern look like locally for you?
