title: Digital Growth & Artist Operations Director (Christian Music Ministry)
description:
Help Build Music That Brings Healing, Hope and the Presence of God



Hello,



My name is Niki Vasilakis, and I’m looking for someone very special to partner with me.



This is more than a job. It’s an opportunity to help build a ministry through music.



For many years I have worked as a professional violinist, performing on concert stages and recording music. As my career has grown, so has a deeper sense of calling—to create music that brings people into places of peace, beauty, hope and the presence of God.



I believe music has the power to quiet anxious hearts, comfort people in grief, inspire worship, and point people towards something eternal.



I want to spend my life creating that kind of music.



To do that well, I need someone who is passionate about helping that music reach the people who need it most.



I’m praying for someone who loves Jesus, believes that excellence honours God, and sees digital media as a powerful tool for ministry.



The Vision



The vision is to build an international online presence centred around music that brings healing, hope and peace to people around the world.



This includes:



* Beautiful violin recordings

* Cinematic instrumental music

* Worship-inspired music

* Concert films

* Devotional and reflective content

* Storytelling through music

* Resources that nurture the soul of artists

* Future creative projects that point people towards beauty, hope and the love of Christ



Every recording, every video and every project is created with the desire that someone, somewhere, would encounter hope through music.



The Role



I’m looking for a Digital Growth & Artist Operations Director to become my long-term strategic partner.



This is not an artist management role.



You won’t be booking concerts, managing performances or representing me professionally.



Instead, your mission is to ensure that every piece of music and every creative project reaches the widest possible audience online.



You will oversee the digital side of the ministry by helping manage and grow:



* My website

* Spotify

* Apple Music

* Amazon Music

* YouTube

* Instagram

*

* TikTok

*
 newsletters

* Digital catalogue management

* Playlist pitching

* Radio promotion

* Christian radio promotion

* Sync licensing submissions

* Search engine optimisation

* Metadata and discoverability

* Analytics and audience growth



You’ll help build systems that allow the music to travel further than I could ever do on my own.



What I’m Looking For



I’m looking for someone who:



* Has a genuine relationship with Jesus Christ.

* Sees their work as ministry.

* Loves music and believes it can bring healing and hope.

* Is highly organised and detail-oriented.

* Enjoys digital strategy and problem solving.

* Thinks long-term rather than chasing short-term trends.

* Wants to build something meaningful over many years.

* Communicates with kindness, honesty and excellence.



Experience in music marketing, digital marketing or artist development would be wonderful, but just as important is a willingness to learn, a servant heart and a passion for helping meaningful work reach the world.



If this vision resonates with you, and you believe your gifts could help build something that points people towards beauty, healing and hope, I would love to begin a conversation.



Please note that this is my first experience hiring an employee so I am only seeking someone with experience in the listed areas. I am unfortunately not able to employ someone who does not yet have the experience.

• Reliable webcam.

What You Bring

Accounting Experience: Previous experience in accounts receivable, accounts payable, invoicing, or bookkeeping support is required. Experience working in remote or virtual accounting environments preferred.

Technical Proficiency: Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel. Comfortable working across multiple systems, databases, and accounting platforms simultaneously.

Organization: You can handle high
 volumes, prioritize tasks, and keep everything on track.

Problem-solving: You take initiative, think independently, and easily resolve issues.

Collaborative Communicator: You work confidently with others, fostering accountability and motivation. You are a positive, self-motivated individual with clear communication.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Position Overview

The Marketing Specialist is responsible for helping Boeshaar Law attract qualified prospective clients, strengthen referral relationships, maintain consistent visibility in the marketplace, and track the effectiveness of all marketing activities.

This position combines hands-on marketing execution with regular analytics and reporting. The goal is not simply to “do marketing,” but to help the firm understand what is working, what is not working, where leads are coming from, and which marketing activities are producing consults, retained clients, and revenue.

This role is based on the following roles, which emphasize content creation, social media, campaign management, referral source development, client communication, tracking prospective clients/referral sources/leads, and weekly reporting.



Primary Purpose of the Position

This role is designed to support the firm's marketing efforts by creating compelling content, managing social media, and executing effective marketing campaigns. The Marketing Specialist will contribute to the firm's success by enhancing its visibility and reputation, ultimately supporting business development goals.

The person in this role will coordinate and execute approved marketing activities, maintain marketing systems, support referral and client communication, and provide regular reporting on leads, prospects, consults, referral sources, campaigns, and marketing return on investment.



Key Responsibilities

1. Marketing Strategy Support and Execution

The Marketing Specialist will help implement the firm’s approved marketing plan. This includes coordinating marketing projects, tracking deadlines, following up with vendors, and making sure campaigns are completed on time.

Responsibilities include:

• Assist with developing and executing approved marketing campaigns.

• Maintain the firm’s marketing calendar.

• Coordinate daily and weekly marketing tasks.

• Work with attorneys, staff, contractors, copywriters, designers, website vendors, and other vendors.

• Keep marketing projects organized and moving forward.

• Maintain marketing materials in accessible electronic folders.

• Make recommendations for improvements based on campaign results and observed trends.

This job involves coordinating through tea
mbers, vendors, and contractors, meeting deadlines, supporting marketing workflows, and executing marketing strategies.



2. Marketing Analytics and Reporting

The Marketing Specialist will maintain a marketing analytics dashboard and provide weekly and monthly reports to the Owner. The purpose is to create a data-driven feedback system so the firm can make better marketing decisions.  Responsibilities include:

• Track all leads by source, including referrals, Google, website, paid ads, social media,
 campaigns, events, networking, past clients, and other sources.

• Track the movement from lead to scheduled consultation, consultation completed, retained client, and revenue collected.

• Track referral sources and report which referral sources are sending leads and which are converting.

• Track website, SEO, PPC, social media,
 campaign, newsletter, and event performance.

• Track cost per lead, cost per consult, cost per retained client, and estimated return on investment.

• Maintain current client/prospect/lead statistics and report weekly to the Owner.

• Report on new prospects, leads, consults, proposals, retained clients, campaign trends, and follow-up status.

• Review marketing and sales “glidepath” metrics weekly or monthly.

• Identify what is working, what is not working, and what should be adjusted.

The job involves tracking prospective clients, referral sources, leads, client/prospect statistics, campaign performance, and marketing metrics to support data-driven decisions.



3. Content Creation and Distribution

The Marketing Specialist will help create and distribute content that builds trust, educates prospective clients, and reinforces the firm’s reputation as a tax controversy and IRS defense firm.  Responsibilities include:

• Draft, edit, proofread, and coordinate content for blog posts, newsletters,
 campaigns, social media posts, website updates, client alerts, and short-form video scripts.

• Collaborate with the Owner and attorneys to turn frequently asked client questions into marketing content.

• Maintain an editorial calendar.

• Ensure content is accurate, professional, clear, and consistent with the firm’s voice.

• Repurpose content across multiple channels when appropriate.

• Coordinate with outside writers, designers, or vendors when needed.

Core responsibilities include content creation for blog posts, newsletters, articles, and social media, along with collaboration with attorneys and staff.



4. Website, Social Media, and Digital Marketing

The Marketing Specialist will help maintain the firm’s online presence and coordinate digital marketing efforts.  Responsibilities include:

• Keep the firm’s website content current and accurate.

• Coordinate website edits with the website vendor or make approved updates directly through WordPress or another content management system.

• Manage or assist with LinkedIn,
, YouTube, Google Business Profile, and other approved platforms.

• Schedule approved social media posts.

• Monitor comments, reviews, messages, and reputation-related issues.

• Assist with SEO, directory listings, PPC, and digital advertising coordination.

• Track digital marketing metrics and make recommendations based on performance.

The core responsibilities include website updates, social media, YouTube, directory listings, PPC, reputation management, and web analytics.



5. Referral Source and Relationship Marketing

The Marketing Specialist will support the firm’s referral marketing systems and help maintain strong relationships with referral sources, former clients, and professional contacts.  Responsibilities include:

• Maintain and update referral source lists.

• Track referral source activity and results.

• Help schedule lunches, coffees, calls, and follow-up meetings with referral sources.

• Prepare materials for referral source meetings.

• Send thank-you notes, cards, newsletters, gifts, and follow-up communications.

• Assist with “Team 100” or similar relationship marketing systems.

• Support post-case follow-up systems to nurture past clients and referral relationships.

• Identify new potential referral sources and target-rich environments for the firm.

The core responsibilities include referral source research, scheduling referral meetings, Team 100, post-case follow-up, gifts, newsletters, and relationship-nurturing systems.



6.
 Marketing, Newsletters, and Client Communication

Responsibilities include:

• Coordinate weekly or monthly
 marketing.

• Help prepare newsletters and client updates.

• Maintain
 lists and segment contacts as appropriate.

• Track
 open rates, click rates, unsubscribes, replies, and resulting consultations or leads.

• Ensure communications are timely, professional, and consistent with the firm’s brand.

• Assist with client surveys and feedback programs.

• Maintain professional communication with clients, former clients, prospects, referral sources, and vendors.

The core responsibilities include newsletters, weekly
 marketing pieces, client communication, client surveys, and maintaining a consistent brand image.



7. Event, Webinar, and Seminar Support

Responsibilities include:

• Identify possible speaking opportunities, webinars, seminars, podcasts, networking events, and community education opportunities.

• Coordinate event logistics, invitations, registration, attendance tracking, materials, and follow-up.

• Prepare attorneys for events with materials, schedules, talking points, and follow-up lists.

• Track event results, including leads generated, consults scheduled, retained clients, revenue, and cost per result.

• Provide post-event reports and recommendations.

The core responsibilities include identifying organizations willing to invite attorneys to speak, arranging seminars, coordinating event logistics, managing registrations, and tracking post-event follow-up.



Weekly Reporting Responsibilities

Each week, the Marketing Specialist should provide a concise report to the Owner that includes:

• New leads by source.

• Consultations scheduled.

• Consultations completed.

• New clients retained.

• Revenue attributed to marketing sources, where trackable.

• Referral sources who sent leads.

• Campaigns launched or completed.

• Website, SEO, PPC,
, and social media highlights.

• Follow-up items overdue or needing attorney input.

• Recommendations for what to continue, stop, or improve.



Qualifications

Preferred qualifications include:

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or related field preferred, but not required if the candidate has strong experience.

• One to three years of experience in marketing, professional services, law firm marketing, client intake, sales support, or related work.

• Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Comfortable working with attorneys, clients, referral sources, vendors, and tea
mbers.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Excel or Google Sheets, CRM systems,
 marketing software, and social media platforms.

• Familiarity with WordPress, Google Analytics, Google Business Profile, SEO, PPC, Canva, Adobe, Mailchimp, HubSpot, Lawmatics, or similar tools is a plus.

• Ability to interpret marketing data and turn it into practical recommendations.

• Ability to work independently, follow procedures, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects.

• Positive, professional, no-drama personality.

• Willingness to learn tax controversy marketing and the firm’s voice.



Personal Characteristics

The ideal candidate is:

• Organized.

• Accurate.

• Curious.

• Comfortable with numbers and analytics.

• A good writer.

• A good follow-up person.

• Calm under deadlines.

• Able to manage details without losing sight of the larger goal.

• Comfortable asking for what they need from the Owner or attorneys.

• Willing to suggest improvements.

• Focused on measurable results, not just activity.



Success in This Role

The Marketing Specialist will be successful if the firm has a consistent, organized marketing system; the Owner knows where leads are coming from; referral relationships are nurtured; marketing deadlines are met; campaigns are tracked; and the firm can make better decisions because marketing data is accurate, current, and reviewed regularly.

title: Creative Producer / Video Quality Control — Facebook Ad Videos (Part-Time, Long-Term, Remote)
description:
ABOUT US

We are a European e-commerce brand selling in 10 markets. We run
 and

Instagram video ads at high volume. A team of freelance video editors delivers

our ads to us every week. Right now the owner reviews every single video

himself. That is the job we are handing to you.

WHAT THIS JOB IS

You are the gate. Nothing reaches the owner until you have approved it.

Our editors deliver in "cards". One card = one script = three videos (Hook A,

Hook B, Hook C — same body, three different openings). We receive between 15

and 60 cards per week depending on the season.

Your job is to open every single video, watch it fully, check it against our

internal quality checklist, and d
: approved, or sent back with notes.

You are not judging whether the ad is creative or whether it will sell. That is

not your call and never will be. You are checking that the delivery is

technically correct and complete. It is detail work. It rewards patience.

A TYPICAL DAY

- You open our delivery board and see which cards came in since yesterday.

- You open each Google Drive folder and watch all three videos, start to finish.

- You go through the checklist for each one and write down what fails.

- Approved cards get marked and moved forward.

- Failed cards go back to the editor with clear written notes: what is wrong,

  where in the video, and what you need instead. Never "please fix" — always

  the exact timestamp and the exact problem.

- (Read this line carefully, because most applicants will not: begin your Loom

  video by saying the words FROZEN FRAME out loud, before you say your name.)

- You chase editors who are late.

- At the end of your day you post one short report: what came in, what you

  approved, what you rejected and why, what is overdue.

THE CHECKLIST

You will get our full checklist on your first day and you will work from it

every single day. It is written, it is specific, and it is not negotiable. We

do not share it before hiring. What we can tell you is that it covers hooks,

subtitles, audio, timing, file delivery and the ending of the video — and that

it catches things most people would scroll straight past.

WHAT WE REQUIRE

- You are slow and careful. We would rather wait one day than receive one bad

  video. Speed is not what we are paying for.

- You read instructions completely, the first time.

- When you are told something once, it does not happen again. We do not want

  to repeat a correction.

- You can tell an editor their work is not good enough, in writing, politely,

  and without avoiding it.

- You have watched or worked with short-form video ads before and you know

  what a hook is.

- You are reliable Monday to Friday at a fixed daily check-in time.

- Stable internet good enough to stream and scrub video, and a computer that

  can play 1080p smoothly.

- Working written English.

WHAT WE DO NOT REQUIRE

- You do not need to edit video. You will never open an editing program.

- You do not need to write scripts, come up with ideas, or run ads.

- You do not need marketing experience.

TERMS

- 10- 20 hours per week to start, growing as our volume grows.

We are a fast-growing international e-commerce company selling premium consumer products across multiple countries. Our business is built on systems, speed, quality, and constant improvement.



We are now looking for an exceptional Back-End Operations Manager who will become the operational backbone of our company.



This is not a customer support position.



This is not a virtual assistant position.



Your responsibility is to ensure that our back-end operations run flawlessly every single day.



You will monitor our team, identify mistakes before they become expensive, improve processes, hold employees accountable, and make sure our company continues operating at a world-class level.



If you love building systems, solving problems, and taking ownership, this could become a long-term career with significant growth opportunities.



Your Responsibilities

1. Customer Support Management



You will oversee our customer support team on a daily basis.



Your responsibilities include:



Monitor customer support inbox.

Ensure all
s are answered within our required response times.

Review the oldest unanswered
s.

Review random customer conversations every day.

Verify that agents follow our SOPs.

Ensure agents read the entire
 thread before replying.

Identify incorrect refunds, reshipments, promises, or policy violations.

Give clear feedback when mistakes are found.

Document employee mistakes.

Follow up to ensure mistakes are corrected.

Escalate repeated performance issues when necessary.

IMPORTANT



To confirm that you have carefully read this entire job description, please start your application with the words:



BACK-END OPERATIONS



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be reviewed.



Continue reading carefully—there is more important information below.



2. Chargebacks & Payment Disputes



You will monitor all payment disputes across platforms such as:



Shopify Payments

PayPal

Airwallex

Mollie

Other payment providers



Your responsibilities include:



Check for new disputes every day.

Log every dispute immediately.

Record all deadlines.

Assign cases when required.

Review chargeback evidence before submission.

Verify tracking information.

Verify customer communication.

Verify policies and supporting documentation.

Ensure every dispute is submitted before the deadline.

Track dispute outcomes.

Document why disputes are won or lost.

Identify repeated dispute patterns.

Suggest improvements to reduce future chargebacks.



No dispute should ever be lost because of a missed deadline or poor preparation.



3. Inventory Management



You will monitor inventory and help ensure we never unexpectedly run out of stock & communicate directly with the agent keeping track of quality issues, shipping issues etc & how to resolve them!



Responsibilities include:



Monitor inventory levels.

Track daily sales volume.

Forecast inventory requirements.

Calculate estimated days of stock remaining.

Monitor incoming inventory shipments.

Track supplier lead times.

Identify stock risks before they become urgent.

Recommend reorder quantities.

Inform management when inventory action is required.

Track ?iled deliveries & Why.

Track & Broken/faulty products & Why & how to prevent it from happening.

4. Refund & Reshipment Review



You will review operational decisions involving:



Full refunds

Partial refunds

Reshipments

Order cancellations

Customer compensation



Your job is to verify that every decision follows company policy.



5. Fulfillment Monitoring



Monitor operational fulfillment including:



Unfulfilled orders

Missing tracking numbers

Delayed shipments

Returned packages

Packages awaiting customer pickup

Incorrect shipments

Country-specific shipping issues



Every issue should have an owner, action plan, and follow-up.



6. Process Improvement



One of your most important responsibilities is improving our systems.



Whenever the same mistake happens more than once, you should:



Find the root cause.

Determine whether an SOP already exists.

Improve the SOP if necessary.

Train the team.

Verify that the mistake does not happen again.



We don't like solving the same problems twice.



7. Daily Operations Report



Every working day you will provide a concise report covering:



Customer support status

Employee performance

Chargebacks

Inventory

Fulfillment

Refunds

Reshipments

Critical operational issues

Decisions requiring management approval



Your reports should be clear, organized, and accurate.



What We Are Looking For



You should have:



Previous experience in e-commerce operations, customer support management, operations, or project management.

Excellent organizational skills.

Strong attention to detail.

Excellent written English.

Strong problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently.

Ability to hold employees accountable.

Confidence making operational decisions.

A systems-first mindset.

The ability to improve processes rather than simply follow them.

The ability to be a leader & give constructive feedback



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



Shopify

PayPal

Airwallex

Mollie

Gorgias

Gmail

Slack

Notion

ClickUp

Google Sheets

Excel

Whats app

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Your performance will be measured and evaluations will be made every single day during the trial



Salary:

Trial: 6$/h



Starting salary: $1,
USD/month

depending on experience.



We offer:



Salary review after probation

Performance bonuses

Long-term growth opportunities

Opportunity to become our future Head of Operations

How to Apply



Please include:



Tell us about yourself.

Describe your previous operations experience.

Have you managed remote teams before?

Have you worked with Shopify?

Have you handled chargebacks?

Have you managed inventory forecasting?

Which software platforms have you used?

What is your expected monthly salary?

When can you start?

Please record a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you are the right person for this role.

Interview Questions

Question 1



A customer support agent has not responded to their inbox for several days and there are now 40 unanswered
s.



Walk us through exactly what you would do.



Question 2



A chargeback deadline is in two days, but the assigned employee has uploaded incomplete evidence.



How would you handle the situation?



Question 3



Your inventory shows:



8,000 units remaining

Average sales: 400 units/day

New inventory requires 25 days to arrive



What would you report to management, and what action would you recommend?



Question 4



You discover that a customer support employee has issued a full refund to a customer who simply failed to collect their package.



What would you do?



Question 5



Describe a time when you identified an operational problem before it became serious.



How did you identify it?



What actions did you take?



What was the final result?



We are looking for someone who doesn't wait to be told what to do.



We are looking for someone who builds systems, improves processes, takes ownership, and helps us scale our company for many years to come.

title: Global IT Project Manager

Compensation: up to 140,000 php per month



The Company

DTiQ is a leading provider of intelligent video, data analytics, remote audit, and drive-thru performance solutions for multi-unit restaurants, retailers, and convenience stores. Built on more than 25 years of industry leadership, DTiQ’s SaaS platform integrates video, POS and operational data, AI-powered insights, exception management, and expert review to help operators reduce loss, improve execution, and act in real time. Serving more than 32,000 locations and 2,600 clients around the world, DTiQ helps leading brands turn store-level visibility into measurable business outcomes.

We are proud to offer a collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented work environment where employees are encouraged to learn, develop new skills, and build long-term careers.

For more information on DTiQ visit our website (
) or our LinkedIn page (www.
/company/dtiq).



The Role

DTiQ is looking for an organized and proactive Program Manager to help drive strategic technology projects across our global organization. In this role, you'll partner with technical teams and business leaders across the Asia-Pacific region, Europe, and North America to coordinate projects, remove roadblocks, and ensure critical initiatives are delivered successfully.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys turning ideas into action, thrives in a collaborative environment, and takes pride in keeping projects organized, transparent, and moving forward.



As our Program Manager, you'll serve as the central coordination point for global IT initiatives, ensuring projects remain aligned, organized, and on schedule.



Use this link to apply: 



Your responsibilities will include:

• Coordinate multiple IT projects from planning through successful delivery.

• Gather, analyze, and document business and technical requirements from stakeholders across the organization.

• Create and maintain project backlogs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation using Jira and Confluence.

• Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Software Development, Business Applications, and other technical teams to coordinate priorities and project execution.

• Monitor project progress, identify risks, dependencies, and blockers, and proactively drive resolutions.

• Facilitate project meetings, status updates, action items, and executive reporting.

• Support enterprise Information Security and ISO 27001 initiatives, including activities related to our Information Security Management System (ISMS).

• Ensure projects remain aligned with business priorities while maintaining high standards of quality and accountability.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones.

Please note: This is a Program Management and IT Project Coordination role. It is not a software development position.



What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in Program Management, IT Project Management, or Project Coordination.

• Strong hands-on experience using Jira and Confluence.

• Experience coordinating multiple concurrent technical projects.

• Experience working with globally distributed teams.

• Strong business analysis and requirements gathering skills.

• Excellent organizational, planning, and project coordination abilities.

• Outstanding written and verbal English communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.



Experience supporting any of the following would be an advantage:

• Information Security

• Governance or Compliance programs

• ISO 27001

• Information Security Management Systems (ISMS)



The Person Who Will Thrive in This Role

• Takes ownership and follows through on commitments.

• Works independently while collaborating effectively with global teams.

• Thinks proactively, identifies risks early, and removes obstacles before they become issues.

• Asks thoughtful questions to ensure requirements are complete and well understood.

• Builds trust with both technical and business stakeholders.

• Enjoys bringing clarity, structure, and organization to complex initiatives.

• Maintains a positive, solutions-focused approach in a fast-paced environment.



Working Hours

This role supports a global IT organization with colleagues across the Asia-Pacific region, Europe, and North America.  We expect a consistent schedule 4 days a week, with one day of flexible time to accommodate the US West Coast. No weekend work required. 



Why Join DTiQ?

At DTiQ, you'll have the opportunity to work with talented professionals across multiple continents while helping deliver technology initiatives that support thousands of customer locations worldwide.

You'll enjoy:

• Meaningful work with global impact

• Collaboration with international teams

• Exposure to enterprise IT and cybersecurity initiatives

• Opportunities to expand your technical and project management expertise

• A supportive, collaborative, and inclusive team environment

• A predictable work schedule with weekends off

If you're passionate about organization, collaboration, and delivering successful IT programs in a global environment, we'd love to hear from you.



HOW TO APPLY

As part of our standard recruitment procedure, we kindly ask that you complete your application through Rippling, our global Human Resources Information System (HRIS). This platform is used globally at DTiQ to ensure a consistent and secure way of managing candidate information.



Application Link:  



Once your profile is complete in Rippling, we’ll begin to schedule interviews with qualified candidates. The interview will last up to an hour and may include 1-2 people (the direct hiring manager and potentially a department lead).



Hired candidates will be engaged through an Employment of Record (EOR) at the start of employment. This is a widely used approach by international companies to hire talent in countries where we do not yet have a legal entity, but allows us to comply with legal regulations. This means that Rippling, our EOR provider in the Philippines will officially employ you on behalf of DTiQ Technologies while you will work day to day with our team. Under this arrangement salary, government contributions and taxes are processed in compliance with Philippine regulations. Your formal contract will come from Ripping and DTiQ will manager your daily work, performance and career development. If you have further questions about this arrangement, please let me know and I’d be happy to address it with you.

title: Seasonal Outbound Call Agent
description:
Employment Type: Seasonal Contract (via Native Teams – Employer of Record)

Contract Duration: September 28, 2026 – December 15, 2026

Compensation: PHP 40,600 per month + Performance Incentives

Schedule:

September 28 – October 31: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (US Central Time)

November 1 – December 15: 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM (US Central Time)



About Marketplace Insurance Exchange



The Marketplace Insurance Exchange is committed to helping individuals and families maintain their health insurance coverage by providing exceptional service throughout the Open Enrollment period.



We're looking for three (3) Seasonal Outbound Call Agents to join our team during one of the busiest and most important times of the year.



If you enjoy helping people, communicating over the phone, and working toward measurable goals, we'd love to hear from you.





About the Role



This is not a sales position.



As a Seasonal Outbound Call Agent, your primary responsibility is to contact existing clients who have not yet completed their Open Enrollment forms and assist them in completing the required paperwork to help continue their health coverage.

You'll follow up with clients through phone calls, SMS, and WhatsApp while accurately documenting every interaction.



If a client has questions regarding insurance coverage or benefits, you'll escalate the matter to the appropriate internal team or designated insurance agent.



Key Responsibilities



- Contact existing clients with incomplete Open Enrollment forms.

- Assist clients in completing their enrollment forms during the call whenever possible.

- Conduct follow-up calls, SMS, and WhatsApp messages until the enrollment process is completed.

- Make approximately 100–150 outbound calls per day.

- Document all client interactions accurately in iAgencyPal CRM.

- Update shared Excel tracking sheets with notes and status updates.

- Coordinate with internal tea
mbers regarding client progress.

- Escalate complex inquiries to the appropriate tea
mber or insurance agent.

- Participate in daily team huddles and coaching sessions.



What This Role Does NOT Include



To set clear expectations, this position does not involve:

- Selling insurance products

- Recommending insurance plans

- Explaining policy benefits or coverage

- Providing licensed insurance advice



Your role is to assist clients in completing their required enrollment paperwork and connect them with the appropriate representative when necessary.



Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured through:

- 100–150 outbound calls per day per agent

- 15 completed enrollment forms per day per agent

- Accurate CRM documentation

- Timely follow-ups

- Reliable attendance and punctuality



Qualifications



We're looking for candidates with:

- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

- Previous experience in customer service, outbound calling, virtual assistance, administrative support, or a similar role.

- Strong phone etiquette and active listening skills.

- Basic Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets knowledge.

- Strong organizational and documentation skills.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection.

- A quiet work environment.

- A professional headset suitable for remote work.

- Experience in healthcare or insurance is an advantage but not required.



Tools You'll Use



- iAgencyPal CRM

- Nextiva Phone System

- Microsoft Teams

- Outlook

- Shared Excel Tracking Sheets

- WhatsApp



Training & Onboarding



Comprehensive training will be provided before you begin taking calls, training includes:

- Company Overview

- HIPAA & Data Privacy

- Open Enrollment Process

- iAgencyPal CRM

- Nextiva Phone System

- Call Scripts

- Documentation Standards



Training begins on September 28, 2026.



Compensation & Benefits



- PHP 40,600 monthly salary

- Performance incentive program

- Seasonal employment through Native Teams (Employer of Record)

- Company-issued laptop provided for the duration of the seasonal contract



(A company-issued laptop will be provided to successful candidates for use throughout the duration of the seasonal contract. The laptop remains the property of Marketplace Insurance Exchange and must be returned at the end of the engagement in accordance with company policies.)



Application Process



To be considered for this opportunity, please submit the following:



1. Updated Resume



2. Video Introduction (2–3 Minutes)

- Record a short video introducing yourself in English.

- In your video, please tell us:

Introduce yourself.

Briefly describe your professional background and relevant experience.

Tell us about your experience with customer service, outbound calling, virtual assistance, or administrative support.

Share why you're interested in this seasonal opportunity.

Explain why you believe you would be a great fit for this role.



3. Mock Outbound Call Recording

Please submit a separate voice recording using the following script:



Good morning/afternoon. May I please speak with [Client's Name]?

Hi [Client's Name], my name is [Your Name], and I'm calling on behalf of Marketplace Insurance Exchange.

I'm reaching out because we noticed that your Open Enrollment form hasn't been completed yet. I'd be happy to help you complete it today if you have a few minutes available.

Completing this form helps ensure we can continue assisting you with your health coverage.

If now isn't a convenient time, I'd be happy to schedule a callback at a time that works best for you.

If you have questions about your insurance coverage or benefits, I'll make sure your designated insurance agent contacts you as soon as possible.

Thank you for your time today. We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to helping you complete your enrollment.



Join Our Team



This is an excellent opportunity to be part of a supportive, collaborative team during one of the most important campaigns of the year. If you're an excellent communicator who enjoys helping people and thrives in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and help us make Open Enrollment a success!

description:
About Us



We're a growing non-medical home care agency (Right at Home Henrico) serving families in Henrico County, Virginia. We help seniors and adults with disabilities stay safely and comfortably in their own homes. We're early-stage and moving fast — this is a chance to build a role, not just fill one.



The Role



We need a sharp, detail-obsessed Executive Assistant who is also a strong recruiter at heart. Caregiver hiring is the lifeblood of a home care agency — we need someone who can run a full-cycle recruiting pipeline independently while also handling broader EA responsibilities. This is not a "wait for instructions" role — we need someone who spots what needs doing and handles it.



You'll own:



Recruiting:



Job posting management using an ATS (we use Apploi)

Building and maintaining a candidate pipeline/tracker, with proactive follow-up so good candidates don't go cold

Geographic/zip-targeted posting strategy to hit specific service area coverage gaps

Pre-screening calls or message-based screening to filter candidates before they reach the owner or hiring manager

Tracking recruiting metrics — applicants per posting, time-to-fill, source performance — and flagging when a role is underperforming



Executive Assistant support:



Inbox and calendar management (Zoho Mail, Google Calendar) — triage, draft replies, schedule vendor/professional calls

Document prep — meeting briefs, vendor comparisons, first-draft internal comms

Vendor/systems coordination — first point of contact for scheduling software, payroll platform, and phone system support tickets

Light ops tracking — keeping recurring trackers and dashboards updated with current data

General research tasks — comparisons, vendor options, market info, summarized clearly and concisely



You will NOT be doing: direct patient/client care, in-person caregiver supervision, or licensed clinical work. This is 100% remote admin/recruiting support.



Who We're Looking For



Required:



2+ years of hands-on recruiting experience — sourcing, screening, and pipeline management (not just posting jobs and waiting)

1+ years Executive Assistant / admin support experience

Excellent written English — clear, professional, error-free

Strong attention to detail (we test for this — see below)

Strong organizational skills — able to build and maintain trackers/systems, not just follow one

Comfortable managing multiple priorities independently

Reliable internet, backup power/internet plan, quiet home office setup

Available for daily overlap with US Eastern Time business hours



Strongly preferred:



Prior recruiting experience specifically for caregivers, CNAs, home health aides, or similar high-volume hourly healthcare roles — this is a very different pipeline than corporate/office recruiting and we want someone who already understands the candidate pool and churn realities

Prior experience with a US home care, home health, senior care, or healthcare BPO company

Experience with any of: Indeed employer tools/sponsored posting strategy, Apploi or other ATS platforms, WellSky, ADP/payroll platforms, Zoho suite, Google Workspace

A naturally proactive, low-drama working style - steady and precise under repetitive volume, but willing to flag issues and take initiative without being told

How to Apply



Read this whole posting carefully before applying - we reject applications that skip this step.



Start your application/cover message with the word "CAREGIVER" as the first word.

In 4–5 sentences, describe your recruiting experience: what roles you've filled, what volume/pace you've worked at, and one specific example of a hard-to-fill role you successfully closed.

Include a 60–90 second video intro (Loom, Vidyard, or similar) - tell us about yourself and why this role fits you.

Include your available start date and monthly rate expectation (USD).



Applications without the word "CAREGIVER" at the start, or without a video intro, will not be reviewed.



We move fast - shortlisted candidates will be scheduled for a paid trial task (a real recruiting task, not a hypothetical) within the first week of screening.

Run persistent outbound 
, LinkedIn, DM) to open conversations and book qualified calls

title: Social Media Manager + Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Read this before applying



I am not looking for someone to make a content calendar and post three times a week. I delete those applications.



I am looking for someone who understands why one video gets 400,000 views and the one next to it gets 800. If you cannot explain that difference in specific terms, this is not your job.



=== About the accounts ===



You will run two brands across four platforms: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and
.



Account 1: Houston Meerdink, personal brand (80% of posts)



I am 25 years old, I own a roofing company, and I am building wealth young. The content covers roofing, AI, entrepreneurship, and business, and what it actually takes to build something at my age. Roofing is a real pillar here, not just background. The trade itself, storm work, insurance claims, running crews, and what the business actually looks like from the inside.



This is the primary account and it gets the majority of your effort.



The main KPI is not views. It is making young men watch my content and want to come work for me. Every video should build the case that I am someone worth following and worth working under. Views that do not move that needle are worthless to me.



Account 2: MCO Roofing, company page (20% of posts)



Residential roofing in Kansas City. We sell roof replacements through insurance claims after hail storms.



This account has two jobs: make homeowners trust us with their roof, and reinforce the recruiting message so people want to work for the company, not just for me personally.



Keep the two voices distinct. The personal brand is sharper, more opinionated, more personality-driven. The company page is credible and trust-building. Do not blur them.



Weekly output targets



24 new original pieces per week. Fully edited short-form video cut from footage I provide. Each piece is posted across all four platforms with captions written natively for each one, never copy-pasted.



24 lightweight pieces per week. Carousels, plus text-overlay variations built on existing text-free masters. The master is one visual and we run multiple text and hook versions off it to test what lands. Low edit time, high output.



Trial reels. The text-overlay variations get run as Instagram trial reels so we test hooks against non-followers before anything goes wide. You own that process and you read the results.



Long-term target: roughly 1,000 total posts, about 200 to 250 per platform.



Responsibilities



Short-form video editing. The bulk of this job. Fast cuts, punch-ins, word-by-word captions, sound design, B-roll, motion text, trend audio. CapCut or Premiere Pro. You should turn raw phone footage into a finished Reel that looks like it came from a US creator, not a template.



Long-form repurposing. I record long interviews, talking-head sessions, and walkthroughs. You mine them for the 8 to 12 
nts that can stand alone and cut each into a vertical short. You find the 
nts yourself. I am not timestamping anything for you.



Kick stream clipping. I stream on Kick. You pull the clippable 
nts and cut them for short-form.



Long-form YouTube editing. 5 to 20 minute videos with retention pacing, chapters, and thumbnails.



Master and variation workflow. Build text-free masters, produce hook and text variations off them, run them as trial reels, read the data, promote the winners.



Carousels. Design and copy.



Full account management. Posting on schedule across both accounts and all four platforms. Native captions per platform. Hashtag and keyword strategy. Comments, DMs, and community engagement.



Strategy. You bring me the weekly content plan, not the other way around. Monthly you show me the numbers, what is working, what to kill, and what we should film next.



Trend research. You actively watch what is performing in roofing and trades, AI, business, founder content, and male-audience short-form in the US. You send me swipe files. You know what sound is climbing before it peaks.



What I provide



Long-form videos, raw footage, talking-head recordings, walkthroughs, and Kick stream VODs. I film. You cut.



Requirements

At least 2 years editing short-form vertical video, with a portfolio of that specific work. Not weddings, not corporate explainers, not logo animations.

You have personally grown a social account, yours or a client's. You will show me the account and the before and after numbers.

Written English strong enough to write captions that sound like an American creator, not a press release.

You understand US short-form culture, roofing and trades content, business and AI content, and what a 24-year-old American guy actually finds compelling. Most applicants fail here.

Reliable internet and a computer that can edit video at this pace. Tell me your specs.

Available during US Central morning hours.

Nice to have

Experience with personal brand or founder-led accounts

AI or business content experience

Roofing, home services, construction, or trades content

Kick or Twitch clipping

Real estate

Thumbnail and graphic design (Photoshop, Canva, Figma)

Motion graphics

Paid social creative

Scripting ability

Tools



CapCut, Premiere Pro, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Slack or WhatsApp, Meta Business Suite, TikTok Creator tools, YouTube Studio, Canva.



How we work



I have a documented content system. We find high-performing videos, break down exactly why they worked, adapt them to the brand, film in batches, edit to a written brief, then review the numbers weekly and kill what fails. You plug into that system in month one. As you prove judgment, you take more of it over.



I am direct. I will tell you when something is bad. I expect the same from you. If you think an idea will flop, say so and tell me why.



Compensation

$1,000 to $1,500 USD per month depending on experience and proven results

Performance bonuses tied to applicants recruited and leads generated, not views

13th month pay after 12 months

Paid US and PH holidays after 90 days

This is a long-term seat. I am not interested in churning people.

How to apply



Do not send a generic cover letter. It will be deleted unread.



Send your application with the subject line: HAILSTORM - (YOUR NAME)



Answer all five of these in the body:



Link to 3 short-form videos you personally edited. Tell me which platform each was for and what it did in views.

Link to one social account you grew. Give me the starting follower count, the ending count, and the time frame.

What is the most pieces of content you have ever shipped in a single week?

Pick any viral video from a founder, business, AI, or trades creator. Send me the link and, in 5 sentences or less, tell me exactly why it worked. Be specific about the first 3 seconds.

Based on the volume above, what is your monthly rate?



Applications missing any of the five are not considered.



Shortlisted candidates get a paid test project. I send you 20 minutes of raw footage and you send me back one finished Reel within 48 hours. Paid regardless of whether I hire you.

title: Trailer Management Admin (Urgent)
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

title: Senior B2B inbound Sales & Design Specialist
description:
We're looking for a rare combination...



We're looking for a rock-star B2B salesperson who also has a strong creative and design background.



Someone who can take an inbound enquiry from a business, understand exactly what the customer is trying to achieve, come up with a creative solution, turn their idea into a professional visual mock-up, price it accurately — and then confidently turn that enquiry into a sale.



This isn't a traditional "make 50 cold calls a day" sales role.



Our customers are already coming to us. Your job is to turn those opportunities into great customer experiences and profitable orders.



You'll be working with businesses looking for printed signage, graphics and branded visual solutions, helping them take an idea from initial enquiry through to a finished product.



What you'll actually be doing

???? Managing inbound B2B enquiries



You'll be the first point of contact for businesses enquiring about our products.



You'll respond to enquiries via
 and enquiry forms, understand what the customer needs, ask the right questions and recommend the best solution.



You'll need to be commercially minded — understanding not just what the customer is asking for, but what they're actually trying to achieve.



???? Creating simple visual concepts & quick mock-ups



This is a big part of the role.



You'll use Adobe Illustrator to create quick visuals showing customers what their signage, graphics or branding could look like at the correct scale.



For example:



"Here's what your logo would look like as a 3D acrylic sign on your reception wall."



Or:



"Here's how your new window graphics could look across the front of your office."



You'll take customer logos, artwork, measurements and ideas and turn them into visuals that make it easy for the customer to say "Yes — that's exactly what I want."



???? Quoting & pricing

We have a shopify website and send all our quotes to clients through
.



That means understanding the requirements, calculating the correct pricing, considering materials, production and installation requirements where relevant, and presenting the quote professionally.



You'll need a good commercial instinct — knowing when to protect margin, when to offer alternatives and how to increase the value of an order without simply discounting.



???? Converting enquiries into orders - all over
.



You'll manage opportunities from initial enquiry through to close.



Customer enquiry ? Understanding the brief ? Creative concept ? Illustrator mock-up ? Quote ? Follow-up ? Sale



That includes following up quotes, answering questions, overcoming objections, recommending alternatives and making sure opportunities don't fall through the cracks.



You don't need to be pushy or overly salesy.



We're looking for someone who is confident, consultative and commercially sharp.



???? Helping customers make better decisions



A big part of our value is helping customers who don't necessarily know exactly what they want.



They might say:



"We've just moved into a new office and need something for this wall."



You'll be able to take that vague brief and turn it into a clear recommendation:



What should they buy?

What size should it be?

What material would work best?

How will it look?

What will it cost?



That's where your combination of sales + design + commercial thinking really comes into its own.



Who we're looking for



We're looking for someone experienced, ambitious and seriously good at what they do.



You'll probably have experience in one or more of the following:



B2B sales

Inbound sales

Signage / print / graphics

Large-format print

Interior branding

Exhibition graphics

Commercial design

Graphic design

Digital print

Branding / marketing production



But your background doesn't have to tick every box.



What matters is that you're commercially minded, creative and know how to deal with customers.



You must be confident using Adobe Illustrator.



You don't need to be the world's greatest graphic designer!



But you should be comfortable taking a logo or piece of artwork, manipulating it, creating layouts, producing mock-ups and preparing professional visuals for customers.



You'll also need to be comfortable working with numbers in GBP, pricing jobs and putting together quotes.



The person we're looking for



You'll probably be someone who:



???? Thinks commercially

You understand margin, value and what makes a customer buy.



???? Has a creative brain

You naturally think about how something could look better, work better or be presented more effectively.



???? Communicates brilliantly

You can talk to a business owner or marketing manager and quickly understand what they're trying to achieve.



? Moves quickly

Inbound sales is about speed. When a great enquiry lands, you don't want to be sitting on it for three days.



???? Has attention to detail

Measurements, materials, quantities, artwork and pricing all need to be right.



???? Takes ownership

You don't need someone chasing you to follow up a quote or move an opportunity forward.

We also have systems in place, and can create more automations etc along the way.



???? Wants to win

You're motivated by results, you enjoy closing deals and you want to be rewarded when you perform.



Who are we?



We are Hyper Creative - a UK based online B2B print, signage and graphics company that has been in business for 15 years.

We have 6 VAs in the Philopines - and so we know exactly how to set you up for success and train you up.

We offer design, print and install services - so the projects we work on typically range from £250 upto £8,000 GBP



Hours - We would expect you to work 9am - 5pm Monday - Friday - London time zone.





Interested? - Next Steps:







Send us your CV along with a short note explaining why you think you'd be a great fit for the role.



Bonus points: Send us examples of signage, branding, mock-ups or other creative work you've produced.



We'd much rather see what you can actually do than read another generic CV.

title: Creative Strategy & Operations Assistant — Paid Social / Meta Ads
description:
Creative Strategy & Operations Assistant — Paid Social / Meta Ads



**Full-Time | Remote | Philippines**



I’m looking for a highly organized, creative, and proactive **Creative Strategy & Operations Assistant** to join me full-time and help manage the creative production process for paid social advertising.



This is not a basic virtual assistant position.



You’ll work closely with me on developing advertising concepts, researching creative performance, briefing editors and designers, recruiting content creators, managing creator communication, and keeping our entire creative production system organized.



The ideal person is part **creative strategist, project manager, creator coordinator, and junior designer**.



You should be comfortable working independently, managing a high volume of creative projects every week, and using performance data to help develop better advertising concepts.



## What You'll Be Responsible For



### Creative Strategy & Briefing



You’ll help turn creative ideas into clear, detailed briefs for our production team.



Typical weekly output:



* Develop and brief approximately **20 video ad concepts per week**

* Brief approximately **10 static ad concepts per week** for our internal design team

* Personally create approximately **5 static ads, carousels, or simple motion graphics per week**

* Research competitor ads, trends, hooks, formats, and creative angles

* Help develop new concepts based on previous winning ads

* Organize references, inspiration, scripts, hooks, and creative direction

* Build and maintain creative briefs inside **Notion**



You do not need to be the final decision-maker on creative strategy, but you should be able to take an idea, understand the objective behind it, improve it, and turn it into something our production team can execute.



### Creative Performance Analysis



Twice per month, you’ll help analyze our advertising creative performance.



This includes:



* Using tools such as **Atria** to review creative performance

* Identifying our strongest hooks, concepts, formats, creators, messaging, and visual styles

* Looking for patterns across winning and losing ads

* Summarizing key creative learnings

* Recommending iterations on top-performing ads

* Helping turn those findings into new creative briefs



You should be comfortable working with advertising metrics and learning how creative decisions affect performance.



Experience with Meta Ads is strongly preferred.



### Creator Recruitment & Management



You’ll help us consistently find and recruit creators for UGC and paid social content.



Responsibilities include:



* Researching creators using **Meta Creator Marketplace and other creator platforms**

* Identifying creators who match specific briefs and demographics

* Reaching out to approximately **30 new creators per week**

* Sending outreach
s using our existing templates

* Following up with creators

* Discussing our standard content creation terms

* Keeping creator conversations organized

* Sending contracts through **PandaDoc** using our existing templates

* Sending creators approved creative briefs

* Tracking creator deadlines, deliverables, and project status

* Following up when content is late or revisions are needed



You should be comfortable communicating professionally with creators over
 and keeping multiple conversations moving at once.



### Creative Production & Project Management



You’ll help keep our creative pipeline running smoothly from concept ? brief ? creator/editor ? finished asset.



Responsibilities include:



* Maintaining our creative production system in **Notion**

* Making sure briefs, references, deadlines, and statuses are accurate

* Coordinating with our editing team through **Slack**

* Answering questions from editors and creators

* Making sure projects do not get stuck

* Tracking revisions and final deliverables

* Organizing completed creative assets

* Keeping the overall creative pipeline clean and up to date



You should be someone who naturally notices when something is missing, late, unclear, or disorganized — and fixes it without needing to be reminded.



## Design & AI Skills



You should have at least basic graphic design abilities.



You may occasionally be asked to personally create:



* Meta static ads

* Carousels

* Simple promotional graphics

* Text-based ads

* Simple motion graphics

* AI-assisted creative variations



Experience with tools like the following is helpful:



* Canva

* Adobe Photoshop

* Figma

* CapCut

* AI image generation tools

* AI video or motion graphics tools



You do not need to be an expert designer or video editor. We have a production team for that.



However, you should have a good visual eye and be able to create clean, professional advertising creative when needed.



## Tools We Use



Experience with all of these is not required, but you should be comfortable learning software quickly.



* Notion

* Slack

* Atria

* Meta Ads Library

* Meta Creator Marketplace

* PandaDoc

* Google Drive / Google Sheets

* Canva / Photoshop / Figma

* AI creative tools



## Who We're Looking For



You’ll be a great fit if you are:



* Extremely organized

* Reliable and consistent

* Comfortable managing many projects at once

* A strong written English communicator

* Creative and curious

* Interested in advertising and consumer psychology

* Comfortable working independently

* Able to follow systems while also suggesting improvements

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable communicating with creators and contractors

* Able to recognize strong vs. weak advertising creative

* Comfortable using AI tools

* Quick to learn new software



Most importantly, I want someone who **takes ownership**.



If a creator hasn’t responded, follow up.



If a project is late, find out why.



If a brief is missing something, fix it.



If you see an interesting advertising trend, bring it to me.



If a winning ad can be turned into five new concepts, suggest them.



I do not want someone who simply waits for a list of tasks every morning.



## Preferred Experience



Strong candidates may have previous experience in one or more of the following:



* Paid social advertising

* Meta/Facebook advertising

* Creative strategy

* DTC or e-commerce brands

* UGC creator management

* Influencer marketing

* Advertising agencies

* Graphic design

* Social media content

* Creative project management



Direct experience in all of these areas is **not required**.



Someone smart, organized, creative, and eager to learn can be successful in this role.



## Weekly Expectations



A typical week may include:



* 20 video creative briefs

* 10 static creative briefs

* 5 personally created static/carousel/motion assets

* 30 new creator outreach
s

* Creator follow-ups and negotiations

* Contract and brief management

* Managing projects with editors

* Maintaining the Notion creative pipeline

* Researching competitors and new advertising ideas



Additionally, approximately twice per month you will help conduct a deeper creative performance analysis and use those findings to develop new iterations.



## Schedule



This is a **full-time, long-term position**.



You will be working remotely from the Philippines.



There will need to be some overlap with U.S. working hours for communication, but the entire shift does not need to follow U.S. hours.



I care much more about reliability, communication, ownership, and output than monitoring every hour of your day.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Any experience you have with Meta Ads, paid social, creative strategy, UGC creators, or e-commerce brands.

3. Links or examples of any ads, graphics, creative briefs, social content, or design work you've created.

4. Which of the following tools you have used: Notion, Slack, Canva, Photoshop, Figma, CapCut, PandaDoc, Meta Creator Marketplace, Meta Ads Library, Atria, or similar tools.

5. Tell me about a time you managed multiple creative projects or deadlines simultaneously.

6. Your expected monthly salary in USD.

7. Your availability and how soon you can start.



**Important:** At the beginning of your application, include the phrase **“CREATIVE OPS”** so I know you read the full job description.



I’m looking for someone who can grow into this role long-term and become an important part of our creative operation.

title: Instagram Outreach + Closer — Commission Only, Uncapped ($189+ Per Sale, Music Marketing)
description:
Maxx Volume is a U.S.-based music marketing company. We help independent artists grow real fanbases through advertising and strategy — no bots, no playlist farms, no fake streams.



We are looking for ONE person to find qualified independent artists on Instagram, open conversations, and close them into our program.



READ THIS FIRST: This is a COMMISSION-ONLY role. There is no base salary and no hourly pay. You earn 5% of every sale you close, on a minimum package of $3,788 — that's $189 per close, uncapped, plus volume bonuses on top.



If you want guaranteed monthly pay, this is not the role and you should not apply. If you're confident in your ability to sell and you want your income tied to your results instead of your hours, keep reading.



------------------------------

WHAT YOU'LL DO

---------------------
. Research and add qualified artist leads to our Google Sheet.

2. Send personalized first-touch DMs from our Instagram account (script provided — you personalize each one).

3. Work the conversation, handle questions, and build enough trust to book a call.

4. Close the sale using our proven script. We give you the full script, the case studies, the objection handling, and training on all of it.

5. Track everything in the sheet and report your numbers.



You do NOT need to know the music industry. You DO need to be sharp, observant, able to tell a serious artist from a hobbyist, and genuinely comfortable asking for money. We train you on everything else.



------------------------------

WHAT A QUALIFIED LEAD LOOKS LIKE

------------------------------

We sell a premium 90-day program, so we only want artists who could realistically afford it and are already investing in themselves.



GREEN LIGHTS:

- Released music recently or clearly preparing a release

- Already spending money on their career: music videos, professional cover art, studio sessions, real photography, PR, playlist promotion, ads, or a manager/team

- Posts consistently on Instagram or TikTok

- Music and visuals are already at a decent level (marketing can actually help them)

- Some traction: roughly 1,000 to 100,000 Spotify monthly listeners, songs with 10K+ streams, solid video views, real engagement, shows, features, or press

- Talks about their music like a business and a career



RED FLAGS — DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME:

- No music released, or nothing released in a year or more

- Poor quality music or amateur visuals

- No sign they've spent a dollar on their career

- A few random posts, clearly a hobby

- Constantly asking people for free promo

- Bio says "DM for collabs" but nothing professional is happening

- Fake followers or obviously fake engagement (huge follower count, dead comments)



Since you're paid on closes, lead quality is your income. Chasing broke hobbyists costs you money, not just time. QUALITY OVER QUANTITY, every time.



------------------------------

WHERE TO FIND THEM

------------------------------

- Instagram: artist pages, producer pages, recording studios, music photographers and videographers, music video directors, music marketing pages, and the artists those accounts tag

- Comment sections under music industry pages

- TikTok: indie artists promoting songs, artists with strong video views but weak streaming numbers, artists asking about Spotify growth or promotion

- Spotify: artists on independent playlists in our genres

- YouTube: professional-looking music videos with low view counts

- Music blogs, show flyers, and local event lineups



Studios, producers, engineers, and photographers are the best hunting grounds. If an artist is tagged at a studio or working with a paid photographer, they are already spending money — that's a strong buying signal, and a strong buying signal is your paycheck.



------------------------------

WHAT GOES IN THE SHEET FOR EVERY LEAD

------------------------------

- 
 Spotify link

- Spotify monthly listeners

- Instagram follower count

- Best performing song

- Last release date

- Why they look qualified (1-2 sentences)

- The obvious problem we could solve for them (1 sentence)



If you can't fill in the last two lines with something real, it is not a lead.



------------------------------

WHAT WE ARE NOT

------------------------------

This is not spam. We do not copy-paste the same message 200 times a day. Every DM references something specific about that artist — their new single, their video, their numbers. Volume matters less than the quality of the conversation. Lazy generic messages don't close, and closing is how you get paid.



------------------------------

HOW YOU GET PAID

------------------------------

BASE COMMISSION: 5% of every closed sale.

Minimum package is $3,788, so that's $189 minimum per close. Larger packages pay more.



VOLUME BONUS — your rate goes UP as you close more in a calendar month:

- 1-2 closes/month .......... 5%    (~$189 each)

- 3-4 closes/month .......... 7%    (~$265 each)

- 5-7 closes/month .......... 8%    (~$303 each)

- 8+ closes/month ........... 10%   (~$379 each)



The higher rate applies to EVERY sale that month, not just the ones above the threshold. Hit 8 closes in a month at the minimum package and you've earned over $3,000 — from one month of work, with no cap.



Commission is paid after the client's payment clears. Paid weekly or twice monthly, your preference, via your preferred method.



If you consistently produce, we will talk about a base salary on top of commission. But you have to prove it first.



------------------------------

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

------------------------------

- Sales experience — appointment setting, closing, high-ticket, or similar. Tell us what you sold and what you closed.

- Excellent written and spoken English. You'll be messaging and speaking with U.S.-based artists.

- Comfortable on Instagram, TikTok, Spotify, and YouTube

- Strong research instincts — you enjoy digging and connecting dots

- Organized with Google Sheets

- Self-motivated. Nobody is going to monitor your hours. Your results are the only thing measured.

- Stable internet and a computer (this is not phone-only work)

- Bonus: you like music, follow artists, or have run social accounts before



------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

------------------------------

Applications that skip these steps get deleted. This is the filter.



1. Start your message with the word "VOLUME" so I know you read the whole post.



2. Answer these questions:

   a) What have you sold before, at what price point, and what were your actual numbers?

   b) Are you genuinely comfortable working commission-only? Be honest — I'd rather know now.

   c) How many hours per week can you commit, and what are your working hours in EST?

   d) What is one specific thing you would look at on an artist's Instagram to tell whether they are spending real money on their career?



3. Do this short sample task — this is what actually gets you hired:

   Go find ONE real independent artist on Instagram who fits the criteria above. Send me:

   - Their 
 Their Spotify monthly listeners

   - Their last release date

   - Two sentences on why you think they're qualified

   - One sentence on the problem we could solve for them

   - A 3-4 sentence DM you would send them (in your own words)



4. If you have a voice recording or Loom of yourself speaking, send it. Not required, but it moves you to the front of the line.



I read every application that follows the instructions. Full training, scripts, and case studies provided from day one.
